Als Lauras Schwester Ana heiratet, reist Laura von Buenos Aires in ihr spanisches Heimatdorf. Dort hat ihre Jugendliebe Paco, dem sie ihr Familienerbe verkauft hat, ein Weingut gegründet. Dann wird plötzlich Lauras Tochter Irene entführt und es treten einige Familiengeheimnisse ans Licht.

Der Geologe Colin Devey erkundet, wie Wind, Eis und Wasser die Anden formen. Von Patagonien bis zur Atacama-Wüste zeigt die Dokumentation ein faszinierendes Naturlabor, in dem atmosphärische Kräfte die einzigartigen Landschaften bilden.
pr.sub: Expedition Anden - Die Kraft von Wind und Wasser

Eine faszinierende Reise führt nach Costa Rica, das Bindeglied zwischen Nord- und Südamerika. Auf einer schmalen Landzunge gelegen, trennt es den Pazifischen Ozean von der Karibischen See und steht auf der Liste der Biodiversität ganz weit oben.

Die Schweizer Bergbahnen führen durch majestätische Landschafte. Diese Folge führt mit der Zahnradbahn auf den Monte Generoso. Vom Gipfel auf 1601 Metern hat man einen spektakulären Rundumblick auf die höchsten Berge der Schweizer Alpen.

Das Bellevue des Alpen und die Schatzalp sind zwei legendäre Berghotels. Die dritte Folge erzählt von ihren Besitzern, ihren Gästen und der magischen Anziehungskraft der Alpen. Berghotels als Stützpunkt und Zuflucht: Während Abenteurer und Alpinisten im Bellevue letzte Kraft sammelten, um die berühmt-berüchtigte Eiger-Nordwand zu bezwingen, fuhr das feine Bürgertum nach Davos, um im Luxussanatorium Heilung an Körper und Seele zu finden.

Die letzte Folge der Reihe stellt zwei weltberühmte Stadthotels vor: The Dolder Grand in Zürich und Les Trois Rois in Basel. Sie sind Treffpunkte der High Society - damals wie heute. Städte pulsieren, wachsen, verändern sich - und mit ihnen die Hotels. In den traditionsreichen Häusern lässt sich erleben, wie sehr sich die modernen Lebens- und Reisegewohnheiten verändert haben.

In Teil eins geht es um das Montreux Palace und das Monte Rosa: zwei Hotels, die von den Anfängen der Schweizer Tourismusgeschichte erzählen. Hinter ihren ehrwürdigen Gemäuern verbergen sich auch die Hinterlassenschaften von britischen Reisenden, die die Hotels und ihre Umgebung zu dem machten, was sie heute sind: touristische Sehnsuchtsorte. Die ersten Gäste im Hotel Monte Rosa, der ältesten Herberge des hochalpinen Ferienorts Zermatt, waren Forscher, Literaten und Künstler.

Der arbeitslose Komponist Clément Mathieu erhält 1949 eine Anstellung als Aufseher in einem französischen Internat für schwer erziehbare Jungen. Dessen Direktor, ein unfähiger Pädagoge, traktiert seine Schüler nur mit Prügel und Arrest. Gegen den Widerstand des Direktors gründet Mathieu einen Chor und gewinnt allmählich das Vertrauen seiner widerspenstigen Schützlinge.

pr.t: Schätze der Welt - Erbe der Menschheit
pr.d: In ihrer Blütezeit, im ersten Jahrtausend nach Christus, bauten die Maya die Stadt Chichén Itzá auf der mexikanischen Halbinsel Yucatán. Nur wenige 100 Jahre später ging ihre Kultur unter. Urwald überwucherte die verwaiste Stadt, bis sie Ende des 19. Jahrhunderts wiederentdeckt und freigelegt wurde. Seitdem suchen Archäologen nach dem Grund für den Untergang der Maya.
pr.sub: Chichen-Itza: Das Geheimnis vom Untergang der Maya (Mexiko)

pr.d: Es geht um das Wichtigste aus Politik, Wirtschaft, Kultur, Sport und Wissenschaft. Korrespondenten der ARD sorgen für schnelle und präzise News. Die Tagesschau-Ausgaben zur vollen Stunde werden teilweise mit Videotext-Untertiteln ausgestrahlt.

Der Kommissar Hamza Kulina trifft seine Ex-Freundin Almila auf einer Mahnwache für Opfer eines Hochhausbrandes wieder. Almila bittet ihn um Hilfe, da ein Untersuchungsausschuss droht, ergebnislos zu enden. Sie vermutet billiges, nicht vorschriftsmäßiges Dämmmaterial als Brandursache. Hamza und seine Kollegin Maryam Azadi ermitteln und stoßen über einen Todesfall auf den Geschäftsführer eines Baustoffkonzerns mit politischen Kontakten. Die Suche nach der Wahrheit bringt die Kommissare in Gefahr.

Die Geologin Ina Sedlitz kehrt nach vielen Jahren in ihr Heimatdorf Neukirch zurück. Ina will nur eines: ihren Erbteil am Familienhotel an ihre Nichte Mara übertragen und endgültig mit der Vergangenheit abschließen. Doch als sie gebeten wird, ein geologisches Gutachten für den künstlich angelegten See zu erstellen, stößt sie auf gefährliche Instabilitäten und auf die Schatten eines wohl lange verdrängten Familiengeheimnisses. Ina steht vor einer Entscheidung, die alles verändert.

Der 19-jährige Talib stirbt auf dem Polizeirevier an seinen schweren Verletzungen. Daraufhin kommt es zu heftigen Protesten in einem dänischen Getto. Zwei ungleiche Polizisten werden auf Streife geschickt, um die heftigen Unruhen unter Kontrolle zu bringen. Als sie jedoch einen der Unruhestifter festnehmen, eskaliert die Situation. Die beiden Gesetzeshüter sind gezwungen, mit dem Gefangenen zu fliehen, doch der Vorort verwandelt sich immer mehr zu einem Bürgerkriegsschauplatz.

Dichte Wälder, weite Seenlandschaften und Häuser wie aus dem Märchenbuch: Schweden gehört zu den populärsten europäischen Reisezielen. Die Reise beginnt in Motala am Göta-Kanal. In dem verschlafenen Dörfchen trifft Reporterin Andrea Jansen auf Olaf Svensson. Der ehemalige Topmanager hat vor Jahren seinen Beruf aufgegeben, um sich seinen größten Wunsch zu erfüllen: Kapitän zu sein auf einem eigenen Schiff.

pr.d: Die Markthallen von Dijon sind ein riesiges Areal mit über 700 Ständen, die sich auf vier Pavillons verteilen. Die äußeren Stände bieten eine vielfältige Auswahl an Fleisch, Geflügel und Wurstwaren. Bio-Gemüse und ein Käsesortiment sind im Zentrum.

pr.d: Der fast einen Kilometer lange Hamburger Isemarkt ist einer der bedeutendsten Märkte, die die Stadt zu bieten hat. Unter dem Hochbahnviadukt zwischen zwei U-Bahn-Stationen sammeln sich 200 Stände mit Obst, Brot, Gemüse, Fisch, Backwaren und Bonbons.
pr.sub: Im Bauch von Hamburg - Der Isemarkt

pr.sub: Im Bauch von Ljubljana - Der Zentralmarkt

pr.d: Der Stollen ist in Sachsen eine Art Nationalheiligtum. Die Dresdenerin Marianne Van Aertryck ist Ernährungsberaterin und bäckt zum ersten Mal einen veganen Stollen. Für den Dresdner Bäckermeister Frank Gehre ist ein Stollen ohne Butter kein Original.
Die Nachrichtensendung bereitet täglich das aktuelle Tagesgeschehen auf.

Der Centraltirgus in Riga ist einer der größten Lebensmittelmärkte Europas. Der Markt, dessen Hallen sich an die für ihre Jugendstil-Architektur berühmte Altstadt anschließen, überrascht seine Besucher mit Spezialitäten aus den ausgedehnten Wäldern des Landes, seinen Birkenhainen, Flachlandgebieten und zahlreichen Flüssen. Die Art des Brotbackens, des Angelns und auch des Melkens der Birken im Frühjahr beruht auf alten Traditionen.

Während des Vormarsches von Hitlers Truppen nach Westen werden im Mai 1940 etwa 400.000 alliierte Soldaten in dem nordfranzösischen Küstenort Dünkirchen eingeschlossen. Ihre Lage, eingekesselt zwischen der Nordsee und dem Feind, scheint aussichtslos. Doch in Großbritannien ersinnt man einen tollkühnen Rettungsplan: Unterstützt von Bodentruppen und Piloten der RAF sollen die Eingeschlossenen mit zahllosen kleinen Schiffen und Booten übers Wasser evakuiert werden.

Die deutsche U-Boot-Flotte hatten noch lange nach dem Ende des Zweiten Weltkriegs den Ruf, nahezu unbesiegbar gewesen zu sein. Tatsächlich waren Hitlers Graue Wölfe aber eher eine psychologische Waffe, ganz im Sinne der NS-Propaganda.

Features a look at some of the arrests from across the country; a man arrested at sea tries to swim away from police; a man wearing a blue bonnet steals baby formula; a mum goes to extreme measures with a housemate and is arrested for assault.
A hyped-up man goes toe to toe with police; a woman flips off fellow drivers while dancing in the street; a pilot is arrested for allegedly stealing a plane; and more.
On Halloween night in 2004 the police receive over 50 UFO reports in the Chicago area. And in Buck's County, a contractor sees a large object pass over his home.
US Air Force reservists are pursued by lights while flying back to their base. Plus, constable Godfrey loses consciousness when he investigates a strange disruption.
A hitchhiker spots a pattern of lights and is terrified when they seem to attack him. A sighting in France becomes one of the most investigated cases in UFO history.
Strange light patterns are seen across multiple counties in Texas. In France, after an intense encounter, a man's previous knee injury is completely healed.
In Nova Scotia, a former naval officer sees five bright lights in the skies. He is able to see a cigar-shaped object behind the light, about 20 feet in length.
Cousins Billy and John Smith encounter a massive ship triple the size of a football stadium, and guards at Malmstrom Air Force Base in Montana spot an unidentified object overhead.
Les has finally heard enough from Seth and Ashley about his bum watch band deal and bets that he can sell them off just to get the kids off his back and Ashley turns barber for a day.

Following the quirky day-to-day operations of American Jewelry and Loan, a family-owned and operated pawn shop in Detroit, Michigan. This time, Seth and Ashley start the day with a wager that leaves one of them dressed to the nines.

Ashley is livid when she gets cut out of a deal by Les and Seth. Trying to keep the peace and the business running smoothly, Les separates the siblings, but the battle spills onto the sales floor in a huge way.
The sibling rivalry between Seth and Ashley is at an all-time high and when Ashley faces down not one, but two baseball deals that are clearly outside her comfort zone, Seth cries foul.
Brawling isn't exactly out of the ordinary at American Jewelry and Loan, but when customers start throwing down in the car park before the doors even open, Les knows it's a bad sign.

With Les out of commission, Seth and Ashley run the shop as co-managers, but when Seth's decision to cut back on staff leaves Ashley alone on the floor with one too many crazy customers, it's clear that sharing duties just won't work.

Rick and Chum kick it with a rare pair of Pumas from 1968. Next, Chum is blown away by a fan from the 1940s. Later, Rick reads into a collection of letters from historical figures, but it's some lab notes by Marie Curie that really leave him glowing.
Chum chases down a lead on a 1963 Fiat Microcar. Next, Jake gets a lesson from big brother Corey when a rare musical instrument enters the shop. Rick and Corey disagree on a set of billiard balls.
The final showdown of the series sees the Berniers pitted against the Taylors in San Pedro, where they're bidding on shipping containers worth a fortune.
A mystery item sends the teams into overdrive but Brandon and Lori are determined to win. What exactly is hidden inside and will their rivals fight back?
The stakes are high when a safe starts a bidding war. But can the lucky winner get inside? Later, Brandon and Lori disagree on the value of a bin with a Chinese dragon.
A deadly bin puts all the buyers on edge; It's a bad omen that casts a dark shadow over the day; Brandon and Lori square off against Scott and Chrissy in a do-or-die bidding war.
Back in Montebello, Gunter comes along to help Rene, who won't give him the time of day. Darrell tries to make Kimber his queen, while Ivy and his boys Rochambeau their way to a solid showing.

Dusty and Lupe pedal their way to an auction in Fullerton, but end up needing the truck. Darrell pins his hopes on a small locker for which he overpaid. Rene makes the most of the Honeymoon unit and things get a bit racy.
Ivy takes on a supervisory role in Stanton, and it leads him to a bit of Slavic success. Brandi tries to help Danielle outfit her new flat. Lisa gambles on a painting.

Lisa returns to Moreno Valley, where it all started, and gets nostalgic with her locker. Kenny welcomes a new granddaughter to the clan and would love to find an appropriate unit. Dusty and Lupe put a little elbow grease into their purchase.
Brandi is fired up about expanding her brand in San Bernardino. Rene is positive that everyone is out to get him. Dusty tackles a locker dustier than him. Kenny is a mess.

Ivy drags Isaiah to Victorville as punishment for getting C's on his report card. Kenny wants to furnish his new house, but there are eight reasons standing in his way. And not to be cheesy, but Lisa learns a lot.

Lisa comes to Montebello with a clear mind, intent on letting the lockers speak to her. Ivy lets his son navigate his way to a unit which turns out not to be completely vacant. Kenny is absolutely appalled by what he finds abandoned in his unit.

pr.t: Gordon Ramsay's 24 Hours to Hell and Back
pr.d: At Hermosa Beach in California, Gordon attempts to save Patrick Molloy's, a family-owned Irish pub, by refurbishing the dining room and creating a simplified and delicious menu.
Toxic ideologies infiltrate Helen and Steve's relationship.
Helen faces an impossible choice as Steve's façade collapses in a terrifying, violent unravelling, and she begins to plot her escape.
Rescue dogs seek loving new owners at Wood Green, The Animals Charity, including Olivia the blind spaniel, Bella the confident, playful Staffie, and a shy but cuddly pooch called Cech.
Bart uses a miniature camera to spy on a bachelor party Homer is attending where there is an exotic belly dancer.
Principal Skinner persuades Homer and Marge to place their son on a student exchange programme. Meanwhile, an Albanian child comes to Springfield intent on a spot of industrial espionage.

Mr Teal offers Sam employment at bar in Cancun, Mexico, and hires a one-month exchange bartender. Sam accepts, leaving Rebecca alone and miserable with Mr Teal. One month later, Sam decides he would like to stay in Mexico.
pr.sub: One Happy Chappy in a Snappy Serape

pr.d: Eddie LeBec returns for a Boston ice show with an attractive East German skater, Franzi Schrempf, making Carla jealous. On the other hand, Sam is desperate to seduce Franzi, who repeatedly rejects his advances.

Frasier and Lilith fire their interior decorator for mocking their taste and notice house-painter Norm artfully rearranging their furniture. Although fearful of losing his reputation as a beer-guzzling lazy nobody, Norm decorates the Cranes' home.
Ray thinks a family portrait would make a great Christmas present for his parents, until Marie and Debra clash over who counts as family.
Ray and Debra have wildly differing opinions of how to react to the news that Ally has been bullying another child on the school bus.
Ray decides to imitate his father by going to church every week, until he realises why it is he never misses a sermon.

Springfield launches a film festival and `Pocahontas', Barney's haunting meditation on his alcoholism, is on course to win. However, panellist Homer prefers Hans Moleman's `Man Getting Hit by Football'.
Milhouse is forced to toughen up when he learns his parents are lost at sea. Meanwhile, Homer's lack of romantic zeal becomes a problem.

Marge starts up a new women-only gym in Springfield and Homer frets about losing her after she becomes a highly successful businesswoman. Meanwhile, Coolsville, a new comic bookshop, opens up in Springfield and puts Comic Book Guy out of business.
Presenters Tim Lovejoy and Simon Rimmer mix a cookery show with a chat show, where they cook in the kitchen and are accompanied by the week's celebrity guest.
Newly-crowned Antonelli has set the pace all year, but last year's winner Verstappen will be looking to continue his run of strong performances. Who'll take the chequered flag in Sin City?

🏌️ [Golf] Golf fan Peggy can't think of anywhere else she'd rather buy a holiday home than on Spain's Costa del Sol. Danni Menzies tees up five properties for £115k, but will any score a hole in one?

Playboy vet Henry sets his heart on romancing Lucy, but she has short-term memory loss and can't remember anything that happened the day before. So every morning, Henry has to woo her again. Her friends and family are very protective, and Henry must convince them that he's in it for love.
Channel 4's flagship news programme. With sport and weather.

pr.sub: The One Where Chandler Takes a Bath

pr.sub: The One With the Secret Closet

pr.d: Monica prepares for a sexy Valentine's Day, but Chandler is too shell-shocked after accidentally viewing Rachel's birthing video. Meanwhile, Phoebe gives Joey the world's most cheerful dog.
pr.sub: The One With the Birthing Video

pr.sub: The One Where Joey Tells Rachel

pr.sub: The One With the Tea Leaves

pr.d: Phoebe brings her irritatingly cheerful boyfriend to Mr and Mrs Geller's 35th anniversary party. Meanwhile, Ross is stunned when his parents ask him and the pregnant Rachel to feign marriage to avoid scandal.

Joey is thrilled when his name is used in a 'Soap Opera Digest' crossword puzzle. He is reluctant to let the magazine do a profile of him, but Rachel tries to persuade him to reconsider so that he can mention her.

Monica and Phoebe host Rachel's baby shower but forget to invite her mother. Rachel realises she is clueless about caring for the baby after birth. Meanwhile, Joey auditions to host a new game show called 'Bamboozled'.
pr.sub: The One With the Baby Shower

pr.d: When Monica's cooking at the restaurant receives a harsh write-up in a newspaper, she goes to a criticism class taught by the reviewer, hoping to convince him to reconsider his opinion. Meanwhile, Rachel gets upset when a cute salesgirl flirts with Ross while he and Rachel are shopping for baby supplies, and nervous about a major job interview, Chandler receives some questionable coaching from Phoebe.
pr.sub: The One With the Cooking Class

pr.d: Eight days overdue, Rachel grows irritable, prompting a bet between Monica and Phoebe. Meanwhile, Joey invites Chandler to his new film's screening.
pr.sub: The One Where Rachel Is Late

pr.d: Rachel waits in the hospital maternity ward with an anxious Ross. To her dismay, she is put in a semi-private room. Then, the heavily pregnant Janice is assigned to share the room with her.
pr.sub: The One Where Rachel Has a Baby

pr.d: Rachel doubts Ross's commitment to her and the baby. Meanwhile, Ross wants to confess his love for Rachel. Joey discovers Ross's mother's engagement ring on the floor.
pr.sub: The One Where Rachel Has a Baby

pr.d: Due to a misunderstanding, Rachel finds herself engaged to Joey instead of Ross shortly after giving birth to her and Ross's baby girl. Meanwhile, Joey can't help taking a look as Rachel tries unsuccessfully to nurse her baby. Inspired to have a baby of their own, Monica and Chandler retire to a hospital cupboard for a little privacy.
pr.sub: The One Where No One Proposes

pr.d: Joey's futile attempts to gain Ross's forgiveness for mistakenly asking Rachel to marry him only result in emergency hospitalisation. Meanwhile, an exhausted Rachel desperately searches for a solution to end baby Emma's non-stop crying.

Rachel's constant calls to Emma's paediatrician force him to reject her as a patient. Meanwhile, Chandler plans to move to Tulsa for work, but worries about whether career-minded Monica is still willing to join him, and Joey and Phoebe agree to find each other companions for a double date.

Phoebe fears losing her latest prospective boyfriend Mike and her self-doubt is not helped by Ross' careless comments. Meanwhile, Chandler is in Tulsa on a work assignment, and when Monica surprises him in his hotel room, she mistakenly thinks that he has a sexual fetish for sharks.

While Phoebe and Joey wait at a fancy restaurant for their friends' arrival to celebrate Phoebe's birthday, Rachel is delayed because she is afraid to leave Emma with a babysitter. Monica and Chandler also fail to arrive on time after having a row about Chandler's urge to resume smoking and then giving in to other urges.
pr.sub: The One With Phoebe's Birthday Dinner

pr.d: Ross mocks Rachel's new male nanny, and Chandler becomes upset when Monica says that somebody from her job is the funniest guy she's ever met.
pr.sub: The One With the Male Nanny

pr.d: When Chandler's former romantic rival intends to sell his flat, insecure Chandler persuades Joey to help him secretly inspect it and the guys are shocked to discover an old videotape featuring Monica having sex with Richard.
pr.sub: The One With Ross's Inappropriate Song

pr.d: On the night before Thanksgiving, Rachel's self-centred younger sister Amy ruins everyone's holiday dinner with her uncensored observations. Meanwhile, Monica obsessively protects her good wedding china, and Joey forgets to join his television cast mates in the big Thanksgiving parade.
pr.sub: The One With Rachel's Other Sister

pr.d: Rachel impulsively gives a handsome restaurant patron her telephone number, and worries that he'll call when Ross is in their apartment. Meanwhile, Phoebe's boyfriend Mike and Ross desperately try to find something in common to talk about when they babysit Emma, and Chandler returns from Tulsa to visit Monica, but must hide from Joey after rejecting his offer of free basketball tickets.
pr.sub: The One With Rachel's Phone Number

pr.d: Chandler is forced to remain in Tulsa over the Christmas period due to a major deadline at work, and Monica fears the worst when she finds out that he will be joined in Tulsa by a beautiful colleague Wendy. While he works, Chandler recalls some of the more embarrassing moments from previous holidays shared with his friends.
pr.sub: The One With Christmas in Tulsa

All bets are off as the auction-goers battle for bargains in Las Vegas. Dustin continues to pose a threat to Brandon and Lori as mystery bins test their resolve.
Emotions run high when Brandon, Lori and Jesse battle over the same units throughout the entire auction. Will the bidders hit the jackpot in Vegas?
Brandon and Lori square off against Wade, and the contents of a unit create outrage among the buyers.
The contents of what looks like an old retail store show its true identity, and a whale tusk could mean a windfall.
Fly-on-the-wall series featuring a couple who bid for potentially lucrative items left in storage. Brandon and Jesse are forced to join forces.
More drama in the auction rooms and beyond as Brandon and Lori enter an all out bidding war. In California, they're about to find out if vomit can really be valuable.
Dramatic auction action. Are Brandon and Lori feeling the thrill of taxidermy when a dead cow pitches up in one of their storage unit lots?
Fortunes are made and lost at auctions in this dramatic series. In Culver City, Brandon should change his name to Bond after winning loads of spy equipment.
Mechanics Will and Gus go in search of iconic British sports cars for under £1000. They find a classic MG F to refurbish, but the car has many minor problems.
The team knows that the BMW Mini is a solid and popular car. They decide to buy one for six hundred pounds on eBay. But cheap turns out to be expensive when problems come to light.
The guys are looking for a French car that is not a 2CV as they are expensive and rusty. But once they come across this one, it's impossible to turn it down.
This once £35,000 car has been given up on. The previous owner can't get the roof to work or the car to run, so they are selling it.
Since the Ford is a highly desired model, the team set its sights on an Orion. The car is definitely economical, but the steering wheel is on the wrong side.
The team find a Rolls-Royce that lures them to Yorkshire. Although it is old, the car is very economical, and the high quality can still be felt.

Gus and Will are after a classic BMW, but Gus insists on a classic Audi that has caught his eye and forces it on Will. But it's the start of a joint love affair as the Audi's great engine and style wins them over.
The guys buy a legendary golf and instantly fall for it. At first everything seems to be fine with the car, but the truth is revealed when they remove the trim strips around the wheel well.

The classic Fiat 500 is too expensive, so the team decide to look for a Fiat 126. Will and Gus hunt for neglected cars that they can fix and flip for a profit, but any losses will come out of their own pockets.
The Toyota Sera is a concept car with gull-wing doors and a 50s-style space age glass roof. It's also extremely rare, and the guys find one that's drivable, but not in the way they need.
The team acquire a Triumph Herald that has only had two owners. If the engine, brakes, and gear can be repaired, it will be a gem.
The four-wheel-drive Freelander was once Europe's most popular car. It looks good and runs well, but it failed the inspection on so many points that its owner gave up.

pr.d: Bluey und Bingo verbringen zusammen mit ihren Cousins den Tag bei ihrer Oma. Sie wollen spielen.
Bingo muss zu Hause ohne ihre Schwester spielen, und sie hat Schwierigkeiten, damit anzufangen.
Papa ist an der Reihe, den Kindern Frühstück mitzugeben und sie an der Schule abzusetzen, aber Bluey und Bingo werden es ihm nicht leicht machen, pünktlich dort zu sein.

pr.t: Miraculous - Geschichten von Ladybug und Cat Noir
pr.d: Marinettes Freundeskreis bekommt Zuwachs. Der Neuankömmling verwandelt sich jedoch in "Sole Crusher" - eine Superschurkin, die dazu in der Lage ist, Menschen zu absorbieren. Ladybug und Cat Noir stehen vor einer schwierigen Herausforderung.

pr.t: Miraculous - Geschichten von Ladybug und Cat Noir
pr.d: Als Chloé zu Queen Banana akumatisiert wird, beschließt Ladybug, einer neuen und vielversprechenden Verbündeten ein Miraculous anzuvertrauen. Sie soll ihr dabei helfen, die Superschurkin und ihren Riesengorilla aufzuhalten.

Mulans alter, kranker Vater soll in die Armee eingezogen werden, um die einfallenden Mongolen zu bekämpfen. Da er in seinem Zustand die Strapazen des Krieges nicht überleben würde, verkleidet sich die junge Mulan als Mann und gibt sich als ihr Vater aus. Ihre Vorfahren sind mit diesem Plan nicht einverstanden und schicken deshalb den kleinen Drachen Mushu hinterher, um sie von ihrem Vorhaben abzubringen. Doch als er Mulan begegnet, schlägt er sich auf ihre Seite.

Tief unten in der Stille des Ozeans lebt Arielle, die Meerjungfrau. Sie ist die Tochter von Triton, dem Unterwasserkönig, aber anstatt ihren höfischen Pflichten nachzukommen, geht sie lieber zusammen mit dem kleinen Fisch Fabius auf Entdeckungsreise an die Oberfläche und sammelt Schätze von den Menschen. Arielle wünscht sich nämlich heimlich, selbst ein Mensch zu sein. Bei einem Unwetter rettet Arielle Prinz Eric das Leben und von da an ist es dann um sie geschehen.

Olaf erzählt die Geschichte von "Arielle, die Meerjungfrau" in seiner eigenen Interpretation. Dabei nimmt er die Figurenrollen von Arielle, Triton, Scuttle und auch dem Koch Louis ein sowie der bösen Meerhexe Ursula in bester Olaf-Manier.

pr.t: LEGO Disney Die Eiskönigin: Operation Papageientaucher
pr.d: No description available · EPGTalk.com
Bluey will, dass Dad ihr beim Zeichnen eines Drachens für ihre Geschichte hilft.
Coco möchte mit Indy Wilde Mädchen spielen, aber Chloe möchte, dass sie ein anderes Spiel spielt.
Die Väter kämpfen bei einem freundschaftlichen Kricketspiel in der Nachbarschaft um den Sieg.

Bluey und Bingo streiten sich diesmal um das magische Xylophon. Ihr Vater übernimmt indes die Kontrolle. Später wird Bluey mit der Unterstützung des Xylophons eingefroren. Bingo ist folglich die einzige Hoffnung, die bleibt.

Papa erhält diesmal eine wahrhaftig merkwürdige Röntgenaufnahme von Schwester Bingo. Doktor Bluey wird indes gerufen. Papa hat dem Anschein nach eine Katze in seinem Bauch. Er muss daher sofort von dem Doktor operiert werden.

Bluey und Bingo sind nicht gewillt, das Spielzimmer aufzuräumen, und finden eine Lösung. Sie beauftragen kurzerhand Papa Roboter, welcher die Arbeit prompt übernehmen soll. Letztlich geht der Roboter jedoch in die Brüche.
Bluey und seine Freunde spielen auf der Wiese. Sie dürfen nur die Schattenstellen berühren.

Bluey und Bingo spielen gemeinsam mit Papa im Garten. Plötzlich fällt Bingo ein wandelndes Blatt auf. Sie möchte es ihrem Papa zeigen. Doch dieser ist viel zu sehr mit dem Spiel beschäftigt und bemerkt sie deshalb nicht.

In dieser Folge möchte Bluey nicht ins Bett gehen und hat eine andere Idee. Sie wäre nämlich viel lieber ein nachtaktiver Flughund, damit sie die ganze Nacht wach bleiben kann. So fliegt sie schon bald durch den Nachthimmel.

Als Bluey vergisst, ihr Lieblingsspielzeug aufzuräumen, nimmt es sich ihre Cousine und gibt es nicht wieder her. Die anderen Kinder versuchen, sie abzulenken und inszenieren eine Pferdehochzeit mit Papa und ihrem Onkel als Pferde.

Dad lässt sich in dieser Episode in ein Hotel-Spiel verwickeln. Bluey und Bingo leiten das Hotel. Dad nimmt die Rolle des umsorgten Gastes ein. Bluey neigt dazu, das Spiel an sich zu reißen. Aus diesem Grund will Bingo nicht mehr spielen.

Bluey versucht Fahrrad fahren zu lernen, doch das ist schwieriger als gedacht. Als sie jedoch ihre Freunde dabei beobachten, wie sie versuchen ihre Aufgaben zu meistern und nicht aufgeben, hat sie die Motivation es noch einmal zu versuchen.

pr.t: Miraculous - Geschichten von Ladybug und Cat Noir
pr.d: Marinette schleicht sich in ein Haus, als dort ein privates Dinner abgehalten wird.

pr.t: Miraculous - Geschichten von Ladybug und Cat Noir
pr.d: Als Malediktator zurückkehrt und nun von einem Sentimonster unterstützt wird, vertraut Ladybug einem engagierten Freund und Verbündeten ein Miraculous an, um Paris zu retten.

Als Taro in der Schule geärgert wird, greift Yuna ein. Er fordert Kennys Dojo zu einem Duell der Karate-Schulen heraus. Stitch verliert ein wertvolles Erinnerungsstück von Yuna und findet es überraschend beim Kampf der Dojos wieder.

Nach einer Bruchlandung findet sich Stitch in Japan wieder. Er lernt Yuna kennen, die ihn bei sich und ihrer Familie aufnimmt. Sie werden Freunde und Stitch lernt Japan kennen und erfährt die Legende vom magischen Stein. Dieser kann Wünsche erfüllen. Auch Stitch hat einen Wunsch, aber damit der Wunsch in Erfüllung gehen kann, muss Stitch zuerst 43 gute Taten erfüllen. Eine fast unmögliche Aufgabe für den Rabauken Stitch.
pr.sub: Stitch gegen Dr. van Hamsterdam Teil 1

pr.d: Yuna muss Dr. van Hamsterdam und seinen teuflischen Plan stoppen. Ansonsten kann Dr. van Hamsterdam sein Ziel erreichen und wird Herrscher des gesamten Universums.
Cricket ist krank und kann seine Pflichten nicht erfüllen. Daher springt seine Familie für ihn ein.

Bill hat eine riesige Wassermelone gezogen. Cricket lädt daraufhin gleich den lokalen Fernsehsender ein, um von der Sensation Megamelone zu berichten. Cricket wehrt sich gegen die gemeinen Mobbingattacken der Cyber Knights.

Mama denkt, dass Bluey noch zu jung für Schach ist, als Papa versucht, ihr das Spiel beibringen zu wollen. Es dauert nicht lang, bis Bingo sich anschließt, woraufhin die Kinder ihre eigenen Regeln erfinden, doch kann Papa nicht immer verlieren.

Mama gönnt sich ihre wohlverdiente Pause und Papa spielt daher mit Bluey und Bingo Schafshund. Dies soll die Kinder davon abhalten, Mama bei ihrer Pause zu stören. Die Aufgabe entpuppt sich jedoch als schwieriger, als sie erwartet haben.
Die Eltern wollen ihre Hausarbeit erst beenden, wenn die Kinder aufhören, sich albern zu benehmen.

Luckys Vater ist empört darüber, dass das moderne Päckchenspiel ein Geschenk in jeder Lage hat. Er ändert deshalb die Regeln wieder, sodass es wie ursprünglich nur einen Preis in der Mitte gibt. Aber Bingo verliert immer.

Blueys Vatertagskarte soll perfekt werden, aber sie kann sich nicht entscheiden, was sie malen soll. Mama erinnert sie an all die spaßigen Momente, die sie mit ihrem Vater hatte und daran, dass er auch nicht perfekt ist.

pr.t: Miraculous - Geschichten von Ladybug und Cat Noir
pr.d: Als seine Plattenfirma den Rocker Jagged Stone zu einem Duett mit dem Popstar Mr. XY zwingen will, nutzt Hawk Moth die Wut des Rockers und verwandelt ihn in Guitar Villain. Unterdessen überredet Bob Marinette dazu, Stones Albumcover zu gestalten.

pr.t: Miraculous - Geschichten von Ladybug und Cat Noir
pr.d: Marinettes Onkel, der weltberühmte Koch Cheng Sifu, besucht Paris, um an einem Kochwettbewerb teilzunehmen. Als Chloé seine Vorspeise ruiniert, nutzt Hawk Moth seine Wut, um ihn in Kung Food zu verwandeln. Der Bösewicht hat es auf Chloé abgesehen.

Mogli freut sich, dass er im Menschendorf leben darf und dort eine Familie und Freunde gefunden hat. Er sehnt sich aber auch nach seinen Freunden im Dschungel. Auch Balu vermisst seinen kleinen Freund und entschließt sich dazu, Mogli wieder in den Dschungel zurückzuholen. Die beiden beschließen, noch einmal eine tolle Zeit bei ihren alten Freunden zu verbringen. Jedoch hat Shanti die Freunde beobachtet und folgt ihnen.
Percy, Annabeth und Grover werden von einem furchterregenden Gegner um einen Gefallen gebeten.
pr.sub: Ein Gott lädt uns zu Cheeseburgern ein

pr.d: Percy, Annabeth und Grover gelangen auf der Suche nach Antworten in ein Casino in Las Vegas.
pr.sub: Wir bringen ein Zebra nach Vegas

pr.d: Jills Eltern wollen zu Besuch kommen, aber sie will nach den Prüfungen lieber ihre Ruhe haben. Sie gibt vor, krank zu sein und sagt den Eltern ab. Wenig später erreicht sie ein Brief, dass ihr Vater plötzlich verstorben ist.
Randy bittet seine Angebetete Laureen endlich um ein Rendezvous. Doch im Restaurant wird er wegen seines Alters nicht ganz ernst genommen. Doch dann taucht Wilson auf und hilft ihm.

Der jährliche Familienausflug zur Haushaltswarenausstellung in Cleveland steht bevor. Jill freut sich, mit den Kindern etwas unternehmen zu können und Tim moderiert von dort aus seine Sendung. Die Kinder haben jedoch dort andere Pläne.
Tim steht vor einem neuen Rekord: Er hat bald mehr Heimwerkersendungen präsentiert als Bob Vila. Doch sein bevorstehender Triumph wird durch eine Schulterverletzung gefährdet.

Brad hat seine Führerscheinprüfung erfolgreich abgeschlossen und will sich Tims Wagen ausleihen. Jill, die darüber besorgt ist, wird auch gleich in ihren Zweifeln bestätigt, als Brad einen Unfall baut.

Im Eros-Center kommt es zu einem Mord. Eine junge Frau namens Biggi wurde ermordet. Die Polizei hat schnell drei Hauptverdächtige. Zum einen ist da ihr italienischer Freund. Riccardo und sie haben sich angeblich am Abend vor ihrem Tod gestritten. Ein Rechtsanwalt war Kunde bei Biggi und diese hat seine perversen Wünsche wohl nicht mitmachen wollen. Außerdem ist da noch ein amerikanischer Journalist. Der hat an einer Reportage gearbeitet und alles dafür getan, um an Material zu kommen.

Rebus finds himself at the centre of a massive chemical cover up, when he investigates a small-time crook's apparent suicide. The more he uncovers about the atrocity, the less the people in power appear to want to hear, placing him in an awkward position.

Crabbe's powers of persuasion are in demand when Fisher asks him to cook for a reluctant witness, and Henderson is intimidated by a shady figure from his past.
A face from Orla's past begs for her assistance: Ben Finnegan is on the run from the police, framed for murder, and being hunted by a killer with a crossbow.

Kate confronts Sun Hill's serial rapist, but events spiral out of control when he takes hostages and puts them in danger.

pr.d: In the sheltered, privileged life of the British in Singapore in 1941, not even the military take the threat of Japanese invasion seriously. However, things are about to change.
It is December 1941, and the Japanese continue their advance southwards, but no-one believes that Singapore will be taken.
When a man is killed, his friend offers to take on the responsibility of his surviving children. As the children grow, the woman must cope with their questions and sadness about their father.
The Dorrit's finally leave Marshalsea, where they meet Rigaud and the Gowans. Amy continues to struggle to adapt to her new wealthy status while Arthur throws himself into work.
Fanny and Edmund continue their liaison despite the efforts of Mrs Merdle. Arthur meets Rigaud, returned from Venice, and uncovers his dark past.

As Great Slaughter prepares to hand St Vincent's to a developer, archaeologist Sister Helena is found bludgeoned in the chapel. With the nuns facing eviction, Sister Boniface must solve the murder before their home is lost forever.
Levelling-up leaders and environmental activists clash in a small town trying to look to the future. With a sabotaged train and a dead mayor, the activists become suspects.

The chance discovery of a camera and rolls of film hidden in a pub toilet leads the team to reopen the case of a young man murdered whilst working in a photography shop. The films contain some suspicious photographs, and it seems possible that the motive for murder was linked to this, but it becomes apparent that the solution has more to do with the DNA found on the camera.

This time on Gogglebox it's 'The Great Celebrity Bake Off for Stand Up To Cancer', 'With Love', 'Meghan', 'Tempting Fortune', 'Fear', 'Bradley Walsh: Egypt's Cosmic Code', 'Last One Laughing', 'Jeopardy' and 'This Morning (toenails)'.
Eternal singleton Nicole is determined not go down the same path as a Bridget Jones. At first glance, chartered surveyor Gary is no Mr Darcy, but he assures Nicole that this doesn't make him boring.

Maître d' Fred and his team open the doors of the First Dates restaurant to more hopeful singletons, including 38-year-old party boy Danny, straight-talking hairdresser Lauren, 33-year-old liver bird Emma and 39-year-old ex-Navy gunner Ian.

Billy plans a pig-themed wedding involving a world record parade of porkers, but prim Steph may kick up a stink at his plans.
Haley's day with Rainer Shine's daughter doesn't go as expected; Luke unintentionally helps Jay with his petition; Gloria, Phil and Cam have a secret meeting.

Jack plans a haunting, horror-themed wedding, while bride-to-be Becka dreams of a traditional Scottish affair. Stay tuned to see if Jack's concept proves to be a screaming success.
Jay and Gloria celebrate their anniversary but can't decide on what kind of gift to give. The Dunphys, meanwhile, join Alex on her college tour.
Celebrations are in order as Haley turns 21 and, while the grown-ups hit a bar, Alex, Manny and Luke are left to babysit Lily.

Gordon travels to Philadelphia to visit a Mexican restaurant called Zocalo. At one point, this restaurant played Cupid to a young couple who met, fell in love and married while working here together. Greg and Mary Russell loved the place so much that they pooled their resources and bought it. However, it seems that Cupid's arrow had a poisoned tip: the restaurant has become an albatross around their necks.

Gordon Ramsay travels to Fremont, California, to try to save a restaurant that is tearing the owners' marriage apart. Saki Kavouniaris took over the failing Spin-a-Yarn restaurant in 1995 and began to turn it into a success. He fell in love with a waitress, but the restaurant and the marriage are now failing.

Gordon heads to Boston for the first of two visits to La Galleria 33, an Italian restaurant opened in 2006 by raucous sisters Rita and Lisa. The two siblings grew up working at their father's successful restaurant nearby, but when they opened their own establishment, the customers didn't materialise. The sisters blame everything from the weather to the tablecloths for their failures.

Gordon confronts restaurant owners and sisters Rita and Lisa with an ultimatum. His stand-off with the siblings is just the beginning of the explosive action. He finds himself stuck in a war between the waiters, chefs and owners over who is to blame for the restaurant's failings. Can Gordon wrangle these hapless proprietors and stubborn employees back into one productive team and save the restaurant?

It's the semi-final and time for the bakers to showcase their patisserie prowess. Their precision, patience and pastry skills are pushed to the limit as they strive to prove they have what it takes to make it through to the final.

When Homer is late picking up Bart from a school football game, Bart protests by hooking himself up with Tom, a surrogate dad from an agency. Stung by being jilted by his own son, Homer gets into a monster brawl with Tom that even makes the news.

Valentine's Day comes to Springfield and Lisa takes pity on Ralph and gives him a card, but when Ralph falls in love with Lisa their friendship turns bad, causing a bitter feud to break out between the two families.

After Homer fails a breathalyser test-driving home from a visit to the Duff brewery, he is forced to quit drinking for a month. Meanwhile, Lisa buys a hamster for her school science project, in order to prove that Bart is dumber than a rodent.

Homer takes on Mr Burns in a labour struggle that rapidly spirals out of control. When Homer leads the workers out on strike, Mr Burns retaliates by hiring robots to replace them and shutting off power to the city.

When a huge snowdrift engulfs the school, the kids rebel, gagging Principal Skinner, tying him to a chair and running amok. Meanwhile, Homer and Flanders' rescue operation is going disastrously, and the fate of Skinner and the kids rests in the paws of a lone hamster.

Detective Scott Turner is an uptight, by-the-book police officer who hopes to leave his sleepy California town and work in the big city. When his friend Amos Reed, the proprietor of a junkyard, is killed, Turner reluctantly inherits the man's dog. Realising that the canine may be able to help him solve the murder case, Turner attempts to adjust to life with the big dog, resulting in much household destruction and unwelcome chaos.

Some familiar faces from Bake Off past battle it out over three seasonal challenges to see who will win the first Star Baker crown of 2023. And then to see the New Year in, the bakers and their family and friends are entertained by Riverdance.
pr.sub: The Great New Year Bake Off

(2023) Action thriller starring Gerard Butler as an airline pilot who becomes a one-man army after crash landing on an island overrun by bad guys. To survive, he'll have to wing it.

Outdoors-loving Richard is planning an ambitious mountain-top wedding blessing hundreds of miles away in Wales for his home-loving bride-to-be Jody, when all she dreams of is a local white wedding surrounded by her friends and family. But with even his best man needing convincing his outdoor idea is a good one, Richard has a real uphill battle on his hands.
pr.sub: The One on Top of a Mountain

pr.d: Roller hockey-mad Luke faces the biggest game of his life when he plans a wedding for his traditional, family-orientated bride-to-be Jaydene. Big kid Luke wants a wedding that's all about fun, while his bride just wants a traditional wedding in the same church that her parents and grandparents were married in.
pr.sub: The One with the Bride on Skates

pr.d: Jonathan tackles a budget-friendly renovation for Jessica and Taylor's home for 16 years, ahead of the large extended family all moving on in new directions.
...Selling: Siblings Jessica and Jason live together, alongside Jessica's partner Taylor and their kids, making it a squeeze. But are the couple looking for one house, or two?

Lisa and Chris bought their Nashville home six years ago, but with four kids and Grandma all squeezed under one roof, it's time to overhaul their log-cabin interiors so they can afford a bigger nest. Jonathan gears up for a radical renovation.
pr.sub: A Home That Doesn't Measure Up

pr.d: ...Selling: Lisa, Chris and family move into a motorhome as Jonathan renovates their log-cabin interiors. Drew warns that their long wish list must be chopped down.
In Lincolnshire and Yorkshire, there's a one-man comedy show, a posh take on some Yorkshire classics, and a big surprise in store for one guest.
Competing to host the best party in Grimsby are straight-talking Mel and Patrick, seasoned ravers Vanessa and Steve and lovebirds Amber and Ryan, whose matching pink outfits raise eyebrows.

The first hosts are pensioners Bill and Hilary, with an evening of classic dishes, day two sees Doug and Patsy host with a combination of fine dining and hippie happenings, and finally it's time for youngsters Micaela and Sanchez to impress.
Carl and Brianna bring the glamour of the French Riviera to Bognor Regis - with lasers and an asthma-friendly smoke machine. Will guests Mark and Lisa, and Justin and Karen, be impressed?
Colie Edison, chief customer officer of Bowlero and CEO of the Professional Bowlers Association, goes undercover at a bowling alley.

Gordon visits Greek restaurant Yanni's in Seattle, where he clashes with defiant owner Peter, a chef who is so set in his ways that he hasn't allowed any changes to his menu since the business opened in 1984. His own family are concerned that the restaurant is becoming trapped in the past, but Peter is determined to stick to his guns.

Gordon heads to the Prohibition Grille in Everett, Washington, where he meets a belly dancer-turned-restaurateur named Rishi Brown. As a boss, Rishi is making all the wrong moves and her lack of experience is evident everywhere.

Gordon heads to country music's spiritual home, Nashville, Tennessee, but his visit begins on a sour note at Chappy's Cajun restaurant. Chef John 'Chappy' Chapman's careless methods have hurt his local reputation.
Gordon heads to Scottsdale, Arizona, where he visits Amy's Baking Company and meets husband-and-wife bistro owners Samy and Amy Bouzaglo, who reveal a shocking contempt for customer feedback.
Gordon fills viewers in on the most contentious restaurant he has ever tried to rescue - Amy's Baking Company in Scottsdale, Arizona. Featuring what happened to husband-and-wife team Amy and Samy.

Alarm bells ring when Sienna realises that Dee Dee spent the night at Abigail's. Jack and Pearl plan their big day. And there's a tense showdown between Imran and Ste.

Zocalo: Gordon Ramsay visits a floundering Mexican restaurant which has become an albatross around the necks of its owners, married couple Greg and Mary Russell.

It's the semi-final and time for the bakers to showcase their patisserie prowess. With a place in the final tantalisingly close, it's no time to flake out...
Brother from the Same Planet: When Homer is late picking up Bart from a school football game, Bart gets a surrogate dad from an agency.
I Love Lisa: On Valentine's Day, Lisa takes pity on Ralph and gives him a card. But when he falls in love with her, it leads to a bitter feud between their families.
Duffless: Homer fails a breathalyser test while driving home from the Duff brewery and has to quit drinking for a month.
Last Exit to Springfield: Homer takes on Mr Burns in a labour struggle that rapidly spirals out of control after Homer leads the workers on strike.
Skinner's Sense of Snow: When a huge snowdrift engulfs the school, Bart leads the kids in a rebellion, gagging Principal Skinner and tying him to a chair as they run amok.

The two remaining Welsh chefs cook their four courses again for the judges. One chef will be chosen to represent Wales in the national finals, taking them a step closer to cooking at the banquet.

Three of Northern Ireland's top chefs - Chris McGowan, Danni Barry and Ben Arnold - go head-to-head with their starter courses to impress this week's veteran judge. Former champion Chris is back for glory and determined to reach the banquet, but he's up against two newcomers with their sights firmly set on victory.

Chris McGowan, Danni Barry and Ben Arnold are cooking their fish courses. Ambitious Ben is determined to steal Chris's regional crown, but under fierce scrutiny from this week's formidable veteran, will the pressure to deliver spell melt down?
It's a battle for the main course for three of Northern Ireland's finest chefs - Chris McGowan, Danni Barry and Ben Arnold. Ambitious Ben is out to prove himself with a perfect lamb main course.

It's dessert day and the Northern Irish chefs are all striving for one of the two spots in the Regional Final. The pressure is intense, and in the end one chef must leave the competition empty-handed.

The two remaining North Irish chefs are cooking all four courses again for the judges - Prue Leith, Oliver Peyton and Matthew Fort. They're joined by a guest judge - award-winning food writer Felicity Cloake.

Mini Patel, Michael O'Hare and Tim Allen are going head-to-head this week for a chance to represent the North East region in the National Finals. Today it's a battle for starter course, and the first chance to impress their formidable veteran chef.

It's the fight for the fish course, as three of the North East's finest chefs - Mini Patel, Michael O'Hare and Tim Allen - are out to impress. After his risky starter caused a stir yesterday Michael is planning another controversial dish in honour of the WI's support of women's rights.

Three of the North East's most dynamic chefs - Mini Patel, Michael O'Hare and Tim Allen - go head-to-head cooking their main courses. Michelin-starred Tim is super keen to bag the first ten of the week, but Michael and Mini are hot on his heels.

It's the North East chefs' last chance to impress with the dessert course. It's been a week of highs and lows, modern audacious dishes and classic masterpieces but with only two places up for grabs cooking for the judges, at the end of today who will leave the competition empty-handed?

The two remaining North East chefs must cook all four courses again for the judges - Prue Leith, Oliver Peyton and Matthew Fort. They're joined by a guest judge - WI president Kirsty Bowen from Sheffield - who will help decide which chef will go through to represent the North East in the National Finals.

Representing the North West are Eve Townson, Matt Worswick and returning contender Mark Ellis. Today's the starter course, and after failing to cook for the judges last year Mark's out to redeem himself, but he faces stiff competition in executive chef Eve and young gun Matt.

It's the fish course, as three of the North West's finest chefs - Eve Townson, Matt Worswick and Mark Ellis - go head-to-head. Eve and Matt are hoping their classic approach to cooking fish will win the day whilst Mark is going all out with a fishy take on a traditional dessert recipe.

It's the battle for the main course for the three North West chefs - Eve Townson, Matt Worswick and Mark Ellis. Mark remains determined and focused on his battle to get to judges chamber this year, but as the pressure to plate up perfection reaches fever pitch, will all three chefs get a dish to the pass?
It's the North West chefs' last chance to impress, with the dessert course. Only two can cook for the judges tomorrow. It's the end of the road for one chef, but who will it be?

The two remaining North West chefs cook their entire menus again for the judges Prue Leith, Oliver Peyton and Matthew Fort. They're joined by award-winning food writer Sabrina Ghayour, and together they'll decide which chef will go on to represent the North West in the National Finals.

It's the starter course for three of London and the South East's hottest chefs - Matt Gillan, Lee Westcott and Marcus Wareing's protégé Mark Froydenlund. Returning contender Matt Gillan is determined to make it to this year's banquet, but he faces fierce competition in the two newcomers.

The London and South East chefs - Matt Gillan, Lee Westcott and Marcus Wareing's protégé Mark Froydenlund - go head-to-head with their fish courses. Lee is hoping his modern plate of mackerel and passion fruit will outclass Matt and Mark's more traditionally inspired salmon dishes.

It's a battle for the main course for three of London and the South East's finest chefs - Matt Gillan, Lee Westcott and Mark Froydenlund. Returning contender Matt is determined to bring home a 10 with his ambitious celebration of the billy goat but has he bitten off more than he can chew?

It's dessert day and the London and South East chefs are striving to secure one of the two spots in tomorrow's Regional Final. The scores are close, so it's all to play for, as today marks the end of the competition for one man.

The two remaining London and South East chefs are cooking all four courses again for the judges - Prue Leith, Oliver Peyton and Matthew Fort. They're joined by Mary Gwynn, author of the official WI centenary cookbook. Together they'll decide which chef goes through to represent the region in the National Finals.

Three of the Central Region's finest chefs - Pip Lacey, Richard Bainbridge and Jason Hodnett - attempt to impress this week's veteran judge with their starters. With big boots to fill, Angela Hartnett's protégé Pip is the only newcomer in the kitchen. Will she beat the boys to claim victory?

The three Central Region chefs - newcomer Pip Lacey, 4th time competitor Richard Bainbridge and returning chef Jason Hodnett - fight it out in the fish course. Pip is hoping to outclass her rivals with a smoked haddock dish inspired by her Grandma.
It's a battle for the main course with three Central Region chefs - Pip Lacey, Richard Bainbridge and Jason Hodnett. Once again Jason is taking risks with his unusual collection of ingredients.

It's the last chance for the Central Region chefs to impress, with the dessert course. Only two chefs can go through to cook for the judges so with everything to play for, who will plate up perfection and who will be sent packing?

The two remaining Central Region chefs cook their entire menus again for the judges - Prue Leith, Oliver Peyton and Matthew Fort. They'll be joined by former chair of the Women's Institute Helen Carey, who will help decide who will have the glory of representing the region in the National Finals.

It's the starter course, and eight of the finest chefs in the country are battling it out to plate up impeccable dishes worthy of the Women's Institute. The judges are joined by WI Calendar Girl Angela Baker, but after Oliver reveals that this year it will be much tougher to make it onto the judge's shortlist, who will keep their cool and secure a place?

It's the battle for the fish course. Those who failed to make it to the shortlist with their starters are hoping to do better. The judges are joined by Kristy Bowen, who knows the impeccable standards the WI will expect.

It's main course day, the half-way point in Finals Week, and those chefs who have yet to get a dish on the shortlist are feeling the heat. With only dishes judged to be perfect in with a chance at reaching the WI banquet, the standards are higher than ever before.

It's the last chance for the eight regional champions to get a dish in contention for the final banquet. Those who failed to make it to the shortlist are going all out. The judges are joined by Mary Gwynn, the author of the WI centenary cookbook.
The banquet is finally here. It's the culmination of months of hard work as the winning chefs strive to plate up perfect dishes for the Women's Institute ladies at London's historic Draper's Hall.

Three top chefs from Scotland are out to impress this week's veteran judge and be crowned Scottish champion. Adam Handling has already won a number of industry awards and is full of confidence. His starter sets out to take the diner on a tour of the UK's best producers. He's up against Michael Bremner, who is hoping to impress with contemporary ingredients including Birch sap and Douglas fir oil. Ally McGrath is celebrating his nation's finest produce and making his very own version of haggis.
Three newcomers to the competition create their fish dishes in a bid to be crowned Scottish champion. The standard is so high the veteran judge is moved to tears.

Ally McGrath has been keeping the veteran judge entertained with his very individual approach. Also, the highly competitive Adam Handling has been showcasing the finest produce grown and caught in and around the UK in his menu. Once again Michael Bremner is out to show how inventive he can be.

One chef will go home, and today the veteran judge finds himself with a difficult decision to make. Inventive chef Michael Bremner is recreating the Scottish desserts of his childhood, Adam Handling is sticking with his trademark Asian flavours and Ally McGrath is tempering chocolate for the very first time.

Scotland's two highest scoring chefs are cooking for the judges for the very first time. Both chefs have decided to make changes to some of their dishes, taking on board criticisms made during the week by the veteran judge.

Chef Josh Eggleton is back for a third time. Last year he made the national finals when his starter was shortlisted for the banquet, this year he intends to go one step further and cook at the banquet. One of his rivals last time, Jude Kereama is also back and out to do better than he did previously. The third competitor is newcomer Chris Wheeler who is originally from Swanage in Dorset.

There are some exciting dishes on the menu as the three chefs from the South West tackle the fish course. Chef Josh Eggleton is hoping to impress with an original take on Bolognese, just one of six elements on his complex fish dish.

It is the main course and chef Chris Wheeler is out to show just how theatrical he can be, and his ideas are surprising everyone in the kitchen. No one knows quite what to expect, and the veteran chef is hoping it tastes as good as it looks.

After leaving the Metropolitan Police, Whicher saves a respectable country lady from a violent robbery in a dangerous quarter of London. Susan Spencer is desperately hunting for her vulnerable niece Mary, who came to London in search of Stephen Gann, the young man who had made her pregnant, and Susan commissions Jack Whicher as a private inquiry agent to find her niece and the young man.

A woman claims to be tormented by apparitions. The story of a teen being attacked by a demonic beast. Rocky Primiani shares his story of encounters with the afterlife.
Chris Houston is haunted by an evil ghost boy. A farmhouse is cursed by the presence of dark entities. Something dangerously demonic lurks in Bonnie Shukofsky's home.
The story of a woman who is followed by the evil spirit of a bootlegger. Felicia Sills finds a Civil War-era ring.
Ron's dead mother comes back from the grave to visit him in his home, while the ghost of Pam's mum surprises her grieving daughter, in an episode about just how deep a mother's love goes.

In Ontario cottage country, an investigator is stalked by a terrifying beast-like entity; in Ohio, Karlo and his team are frozen in fear when they come face to face with the ghost of an executioner on an old jail's death row.
Michelle Desrochers' dream trip to Transylvania turns into a nightmare, while in New York, paranormal investigators are attacked by a dangerous entity stalking an old church.
The spirit of a murderer tries to possess an investigator in an Ohio library, and a woman is terrorised by shadow-like figures in her home in Massachusetts.
A woman and her teenage daughter are terrorised by apparitions, while in Arizona, something sinister is found lurking in an abandoned factory.
A member of the team suffers a potentially fatal paranormal attack in a prison in Ohio, and a mother and son in Phoenix are tormented by a spirit.

Summoning the 18th-century buccaneers who ran a South Carolina port in the golden age of piracy, uncovering the truth about a ghost ship and a creepy bedroom in the city's oldest tavern, and confronting a spirit stalking one of the investigators.

The team investigates paranormal activity linked to an overwhelming number of natural disasters, contacts spirits in a hotel built atop a hospital, explores an eerie bed and breakfast, and finds troubled souls in America's most haunted city.

Sailing to Bell Island, Newfoundland, where the investigators reach out to the ghosts left by a devastating Nazi U-boat attack during WW II, and descending into darkness as the trio reveals a group of ghostly miners trapped underground for 80 years.
Paranormal investigators tap into the history of one of Ireland's ghostliest spots as they find out who, or what, is lurking in the shadows of this terrifying fortress.

The story of a woman who is followed by the evil spirit of a bootlegger. Felicia Sills finds a Civil War-era ring.
A man shares his story of a monster attack. The story of a couple who experienced violent paranormal activity. Holly shares her story of being haunted be her ex-husband's ghost.

The team explores Harlan County's courthouse and jail, seeking evidence of apparitions, eerie voices and other unexplained phenomena. This grim execution site may still harbour echoes of a revenge killing and the region's coal wars.

The team conducts a thorough investigation at White Hall manor, seeking the alleged screaming ghost of legislator Cassius Marcellus Clay. They delve into the life of this uncompromising political figure who is said to haunt the halls.
The team investigates the history of an Old Louisville house where almost every member of the mysterious Brennan family died.

New equipment helps investigators contact familiar spirits at the Conrad-Caldwell House Museum. Fresh data and insights into the Kentucky Anomaly may aid Brandon in uncovering the core of this haunting.

Return to Jailer's Inn, where the team's first investigation finds a moving ball of environmental changes that registered on multiple metres. See if they can replicate their results as they investigate reports of voices and footsteps from upstairs.

The hunt is on for the ghost brother of Diamond Point's building director, who still feels his presence in the city welcome centre. Investigators explore apparitions, voices, and phantom smells that keep popping up in the former family home.
Probe the eerie Civil War apparitions inside a Confederate general's home.

Struggling with the loss of her childhood best friend and reluctant to discuss her pain, Carrie finds solace during a solitary horse ride. There, a paranormal event shifts her perspective on the possibility of life after death.
A tall, shadowy figure violently attacks a ten-year-old boy in his new home.

Germany is in decline. Once the world's most powerful country is now being devastated by WWII. Adolf Hitler has gone into hiding. The dreaded ruler is no longer openly supporting his people. He is slowly losing his mind.

pr.t: The Strange World of the German Dictator
pr.d: Explore the complexities of the man who would become one of history's most infamous figures. From his obscure beginnings in Austria to his meteoric rise as Germany's Führer, dive deep into the forces that shaped Hitler's ideology and his leadership.

pr.t: The Rise of the Nazi Party
pr.d: This documentary programme uses archival footage, interviews and dramatic reconstructions to tell the story of the rise of the Nazis through time as well as the continued rise of Neo-Nazis. `The Rise of the Nazi Party' reveals how the National Socialists exploited economic turmoil to get into power in Germany in 1933 before leading the nation into an era of genocide and military defeat. It profiles the people who helped the Nazis bring destruction to Europe, including Hitler, Himmler and Goebbels.

pr.t: The Rise of the Nazi Party
pr.d: As punishment for the 1923 'Putsch', Hitler is banned from public speaking. Now he employs Joseph Goebbels to feed Hitler's political ideology to the masses.

pr.t: The Rise of the Nazi Party
pr.d: Hitler seizes his chance in the wake of The Great Depression, turning the people on the incumbent Democratic Weimar Government and promising a brighter future.

pr.t: The Rise of the Nazi Party
pr.d: A month after coming to power, Hitler addresses his people through the radio. He promises to make the economy his priority - and the task ahead is massive.

pr.t: The Rise of the Nazi Party
pr.d: Hitler summons Germany's military leaders to a shock meeting at his headquarters. He lays out his plans for military expansion into neighbouring territories.

pr.t: The Rise of the Nazi Party
pr.d: Investigate Hitler's biggest mistake, and explore how the German people begin to see through the facade of the Nazi propaganda machine.

pr.t: The Rise of the Nazi Party
pr.d: Explore how Adolf Hitler and the Nazi Party groomed the German people into thinking the genocide of Jewish people was a morally correct decision.

pr.t: The Rise of the Nazi Party
pr.d: Explore how with Nazi Germany on the back foot, Hitler's attempts to cling to power become ever more desperate, leading to ever more deplorable consequences.

pr.t: The Rise of the Nazi Party
pr.d: Explore how the Allies final advance on Nazi Germany in January 1945 sounded the death knell for the Third Reich, a regime which continued with its lies to the very end.

In the darkest days of World War II in the Pacific, an elite British military team sought to facilitate espionage and sabotage behind enemy lines. This now famous group, the British Special Operations Executive or MI6, faced a critical obstacle.
Europe became a dangerous place to be associated with the Nazi regime as thousands of Nazi officers, party members and supporters of Hitler began to flee Germany.
The ongoing battles in Manchuria, China, Abyssinia, and Spain each serve as a terrible precedent in their own way.
As the war consumes economic, agricultural and industrial resources, the extent of the war is realised across Europe, Asia and the Pacific.
Explores how people and resources became absorbed in the war efforts by occupying forces during WWII.
Explores how civilians became defenders against targets of aerial warfare, and the strategic bombing campaigns utilised in an attempt to end the war.

The cloak of war played a role in the genocide of WWII, allowing unfathomable horrors against innocent women, children, and men. Even within Allied nations, individuals were seen as potential enemies and denied liberty.
Explores the aftermath of WWII in the wake of destruction and liberation, with tens of millions dead and millions more displaced.

pr.t: The Rise of Napoleon Bonaparte a Military Prodigy
pr.d: Napoleon Bonaparte, born in 1769 in Corsica, came from minor nobility and claimed Roman heritage.

pr.t: The Notre Dame Of Paris: A Living Cathedral
pr.d: Exploring the history of Paris' iconic cathedral, from its initial construction in 1163 to now.

pr.t: Catherine De Medici The Black Queen Of France
pr.d: An account of one of the most influential queens of France: Catherine de' Medici. Considered an immigrant, common and plain, de' Medici marries into the 16th century French court as an orphaned teenager.
Newsreel footage from May and June 1940 that recounts the blitzkrieg campaign leading to the fall of France.

Dan explores behind the battlements of Dover Castle and descends into an underground lair. There, he discovers how a vast network of tunnels had been used to defend both the castle and the country for centuries.

Built by William the Conqueror, the Tower of London is one of Britain's most iconic landmarks. It has been a military fortress, a palace, a royal mint, a prison, a zoo and a place of execution, a silent witness to some of the most momentous events in our history. Dan Jones reveals some of its fascinating secrets and tells the stories of the traitors, rebels and royalty who met their end inside its imposing walls.

Dan is in the heart of the English countryside at Warwick Castle. While it appears idyllic today, for centuries it was a poisoned chalice to the Earls of Warwick who lived there and its walls echo with tales of betrayal, bloodshed and murder.
Historian Dan Jones is in the heart of Snowdonia exploring a stronghold built not only as an impenetrable fortress but also as a lavish royal palace fit for a fairytale - Caernarfon Castle.

Situated high on a crag overlooking the river Forth, Stirling Castle has guarded the gateway to the Scottish Highlands for centuries. The residence of kings, armies and felons, its battle-scarred walls have witnessed savagery and chivalry, intrigue, alchemy, adultery and murder. Location filming, stunning aerial shots and reconstructions bring to life its turbulent history.

Dan Jones explores the turbulent history of Carrickfergus, one of the most ancient castles in Northern Ireland and a stronghold that holds the key to understanding the tempestuous relationship between Britain and Ireland.

Dan Jones visits the heart of the English countryside to explore Arundel Castle and the dramatic history of the Earls of Arundel.

pr.t: Home Rescue - Wohnen in der Wildnis
pr.d: In Arkansas benötigt eine Siedlerfamilie dringend Hilfe. Im Spätwinter schlägt das Wetter in den unwirtlichen Ozark Mountains gnadenlos zu. Ashli und Chris Curry sind die Aufgaben längst über den Kopf gewachsen: Es mangelt an Trinkwasser.

pr.t: Home Rescue - Wohnen in der Wildnis
pr.d: Jay und Pattie Crum haben sich ihren Traum erfüllt und sind auf eine entlegene Ranch mitten in der Wildnis Montanas gezogen. Doch ihr Grundstück ist nur über einen 16 Kilometer langen Feldweg zu erreichen, der regelmäßig von Felsen oder Baumstämmen blockiert wird. Da Jay an Epilepsie leidet, sitzt das Paar bei möglichen medizinischen Notfällen praktisch in der Falle. Die Outdoor-Experten aus Alaska eilen den Crums zur Hilfe, um sie bei der Sicherung ihrer Lebensgrundlage zu unterstützen.

Chase Morrill muss zusammen mit seinem Team in West Bath an einem Auftrag arbeiten. Und die Liste der Aufgaben ist endlos: Fenster, Sanitäranlagen, eine Küche und Schränke - all das für das künftige Urlaubsdomizil von Tina Seners.

Rod Hiltz ist ein Naturbursche. Er genießt die ruhige und entspannende Zeit im Grünen. Das spiegelt auch seine Immobilie wider. Doch es gibt ein Manko: Er muss immer durch den Wald laufen, um zum Plumpsklo zu gelangen. Das soll ein Ende haben.

MJ und Meri Sue wohnen seit Neustem in Austin, Texas. Dort wollen sie ihr Geld darauf konzentrieren, ihre Studiendarlehen abzubezahlen, um schuldenfrei leben zu können. Deswegen suchen sie nach einem Tiny House mit Platz für sich und ihre zwei Hunde.

Die baldige Studentin Sarah sucht in Charleston, South Carolina nach einem Tiny Haus. Ihr Plan ist nämlich, dadurch mietfrei leben zu können, um neben ihrem Studiendarlehen unnötige Schulden vermeiden zu können, dabei aber komplett mobil zu sein.

Eloisa aus Santa Clarita, Kalifornien hat genug von ihrem dreistöckigen Zuhause und wünscht sich nun ein Tiny House im englischen Cottage-Stil. Dieses soll luftig und gemütlich sein sowie ihr Leben auf das Wichtigste reduzieren.

Eine baldige teure Hochzeit und ein militärischer Zeitplan, der sie in kurzer Zeit in verschiedene Städte schicken kann, führen dazu, dass die erwartenden Eltern sich verkleinern wollen. Dazu kaufen sie ein Haus, um günstiger und mobiler zu leben.

Sarah und Jesse aus Seattle haben in einem verheerenden Feuer alles verloren. Deswegen haben sie gelernt, sich mit der minimalistischen Lebensweise zufriedenzustellen und sind deswegen der Meinung, dass ein Tiny Haus für die beiden perfekt ist.

Es klingt so einfach: In ein anderes Land gehen und ein neues Leben anfangen. Das fängt bei einem Haus und die damit verbundenen Bestimmungen sind oft sehr anders als gewohnt. Haussucher blicken auf Baustile, Bürokratie und Besonderheiten.

Keith und Tarah wollen aus Seattle nach Mexiko. Sie geben viel auf für diesen Traum vom karibischen Flair für wenig Geld. Aber an der Riviera Maya merken sie, dass da noch mehr gefordert ist. Sie müssen sich von mehr trennen als sie erwartet haben.

Für ein attraktives Jobangebot will ein junges Paar nach Belgien ziehen. Der alte Hund soll mit umziehen. Die neue Umgebung lockt, und sie freuen sich auf ein neues Zuhause. Dass der Hund sich dort auch wohlfühlt, ist den beiden sehr wichtig.

Diesmal will ein Paar aus Utah, USA, mit ihrem kleinen Kind nach Neuseeland auswandern. Sie haben eine Arbeitsstelle in der schönen Hafenstadt Timaru finden können. Sie sind gespannt auf das als familienfreundlich beschriebene Umfeld.
Diese Sendung wirbt für verschiedene Produkte, die man sich bequem nach Hause schicken lassen kann.

pr.t: Property Brothers - Haussuche im Wilden Westen
pr.d: Zwei California State Rangers suchen nach 35 Ehejahren ein eigenes Stück Natur, das an ihr Berufsleben erinnert. Parallel dazu wollen eine Tierchiropraktikerin und ein Hufschmied ihre winzige Mietwohnung verlassen, um mehr Platz zu haben.

pr.t: Property Brothers - Haussuche im Wilden Westen
pr.d: Ein überarbeiteter Fluglotse hofft mithilfe der Property Brothers auf einen ruhigen Rückzugsort für sich und seine Familie. Gleichzeitig wagen eine angehende Olympionikin und ihre Freundin ein großes Risiko: Gemeinsam wollen sie Land kaufen.

Während Austin auf einer Auktion ist, genießt Elizabeth mit ihren Söhnen einen gemütlichen Morgen auf der Ranch. Sie bereitet dänische Apfelküchlein und gebackene Eier mit Salsa zu, einfache, liebevolle Gerichte, die nach Zuhause schmecken.

pr.t: Kitchen Design - Aus Liebe zur Küche
pr.d: Paul und Helen bauen eine Küche, in der neue Geräte mit Antiquitäten kombiniert werden.

pr.t: Kitchen Design - Aus Liebe zur Küche
pr.d: Paul und Helen verwandeln einen Teil einer Scheune aus dem 17. Jahrhundert in eine rustikale Küche.

Der ruhige Küstenort Rocky Point liegt auf Long Island. Dort wechseln sich Wald und Strand harmonisch ab, was die Preise der Immobilien in die Höhe treibt. Doch Sara und Justin sind auf der Jagd nach einem Strandhaus für höchstens 450.000 Dollar. Die beiden haben zwei Kinder und wollen ihre Wochenenden als Familie in der Natur verbringen. Das Traumhaus der Familie hat vier Schlafzimmer, zwei Bäder, eine große Küche und einen Garten.

Eine Patchworkfamilie ist auf der Suche nach einem Strandgrundstück in Hampton, Virginia, wo sie ihren Kindern eine schöne Ferienzeit am Meer ermöglichen können. Die Familie sucht ein Objekt mit mindestens zwei Schlafzimmern für Familie und Freunde.
Daphne und Ian möchten mehr Hochzeiten auf ihr Schloss holen und verwandeln dafür die in die Jahre gekommenen Toiletten in luxuriöse Gästeräume.

Daphne und Ian arbeiten mit Hochdruck daran, das Torhaus ihres Schlosses endlich fertigzustellen. Neben einer Galerie mit Blick auf das Schloss entstehen ein auffälliger Kronleuchter und ein maßgefertigter Katzenbaum für Kater Charlie.

Die Kalamas übernehmen ein renovierungsbedürftiges Haus in Manoa und glauben zunächst an einen vielversprechenden Fund. Doch beim Abriss kommen massive Probleme mit den Leitungen, Termitenschäden und eine kostspielige Überraschung zum Vorschein.

Kamohai und Tristyn besichtigen auf O'ahu ein stark verfallenes und vermülltes Haus, das seit 20 Jahren leer steht. Kamohai sieht das Potenzial, es nach der Renovierung für stolze 1,4 Millionen Dollar zu verkaufen und beginnt den Umbau.
Ein verheiratetes Surferpaar sucht in Virginia Beach nach einem bezahlbaren Strandhaus, das zu seinem Lebensstil passt.

Nach der Geburt ihres Kindes möchte ein Paar den eisigen Wintern in Michigan entkommen und sich in Fort Myers Beach in Florida niederlassen. Gesucht wird ein bezahlbares Strandhaus für das neue Familienleben unter Palmen.

Ein junges Paar wünscht sich ein neues Traumhaus mit tollem Ausblick auf Maui. Ihm ist dabei besonders wichtig, dass es einen Garten gibt, der sich zum Obst- und Gemüseanbau eignet. Das Budget liegt bei etwa 1,2 Millionen Dollar.

Susie und Marty träumen bereits seit ihren Flitterwochen davon, aus Seattle wegzuziehen und sich ein neues Leben auf Hawaii aufzubauen. Ihr neues Zuhause soll unbedingt Meerblick, Gästezimmer und einen Pool haben. Das Paar will viel surfen.

Laura kehrt nach 40 Jahren auf dem Festland zurück in ihre Heimat auf Maui. Gemeinsam mit ihrer Schwester sucht sie das perfekte Haus in Strandnähe mit altem Hawaii-Charme. Ihr großzügiges Budget bietet viele Möglichkeiten.

Mike und Masha tauchen für ihr Leben gern. Nun kehren sie nach 25 Jahren nach Hawaii zurück, um sich dort für immer niederzulassen. Auf "Big Island" sucht das sportbegeisterte Paar nach einem Haus am Wasser und mit Garten.

Wir werfen einen Blick auf ein Paar aus Miami, das sich den Traum vom Eigenheim erfüllt hat. Nach Jahren in Mietwohnungen haben sie ihr erstes Haus gekauft. Mithilfe von Freunden und Familie wollen sie es in ein Wohlfühlparadies verwandeln.

A large piece of land in Ratby in Leicestershire, a terrace in Chesterton in Staffordshire and a 1930s semi with a huge garden and huge potential are all sold at auction. Martin Roberts, Lucy Alexander and Dion Dublin meet the developers hoping to breathe new life into their auction buys.

A two-bedroom detached house in Basford in Nottingham, a top-floor flat in Portsmouth and a large Edwardian terrace in Crewe are all sold under the hammer. Martin, Lucy and Dion meet the new owners and hear about their plans.

A multimillion-pound development in Farningham in Kent, an ambitious, total renovation project in Aspatria in Cumbria and a very small studio flat in Wallington in Surrey are all sold under the hammer. Martin and Lucy meet the new owners to discuss their plans.
A semi in Sutton Coldfield near Birmingham, a derelict house in a rural village near Dover in Kent and a basement without planning permission in Ipswich in Suffolk are all sold under the hammer.

A 20-year-old first-time developer, a banker turned developer and a builder who wants to create a new home for his soon-to-be-wife all buy properties at auction. Martin, Lucy and Dion are in Chesterton, Hornchurch and Sudbrook to hear their plans.

A run-down listed village house in Farningham in Kent is given the wow factor while houses in Great Barr in Birmingham and Crewe in Cheshire are also given great makeovers. Martin, Lucy and Dion meet the new owners and catch up on their progress after the transformations.

Lucy talks to a pastor and his wife who plan to build their dream eco house in Brompton in Kent. Meanwhile, Martin meets a first-time developer in Wolverhampton, and Dion looks at a huge building which already comes with a tenanted flat and a hair salon in Newcastle-under-Lyme.

A commercial and residential building in Beeston in Nottinghamshire, a four-storey house in East Dulwich in London and a flat in Godalming in Surrey are all given high-end makeovers. Will the developers, who all bought at auction, make a profit?

A 1930s semi in Hatfield in Hertfordshire, a flat in Croydon and a workshop and land in Heanor in Derbyshire are sold at auction. Martin, Lucy and Dion meet the owners and hear their plans to make money from their bricks and mortar.

A mum and dad buy a piece of land in Stevenage in Hertfordshire in the hope of developing a pair of houses for their children, a couple who buy a top-floor flat in Motherwell in Scotland want to make a profit on the rent, and two young brothers buy a run-down house in South Normanton.

A bungalow in Langton Green in Kent is given a high-end refurbishment and extension, a father-and-son team cleverly refigure the existing space in a terraced house in Stoke-on-Trent, and two lifelong friends have high hopes for a piece of land they buy behind a house they already own in Northwood in Middlesex.

A flat in Sutton in London, a studio apartment in Chatham in Kent and a terraced house in Middlesbrough are all sold under the hammer. Martin, Lucy and Dion meet the new owners.
