Martel Maxwell joins the team, and looks at an old mews house in an historic part of Litchfield in Staffordshire, while Martin Roberts assesses the potential of a bungalow in Hanley in Stoke-on-Trent.

Martel Maxwell looks at a large terraced house in Dover in Kent with bags of potential, Martin Roberts is in Camborne in Cornwall viewing a house with lots of issues, and Dion Dublin meets a couple who bought a flat in Woodford Green in Essex.

Martel Maxwell is in Gillingham in Kent meeting a couple embarking on their first renovation development, Martin Roberts talks to a man with ambitious plans for a house in London's Chingford, and Dion Dublin looks round a semi in Wolverhampton.

Martel Maxwell hears development plans for a two-bedroom flat in Godalming in Surrey, Martin Roberts looks at a house in a terrible state of repair in Telford in Shropshire, and Dion Dublin sizes up the work needing to be done at a terraced house in Smethwick in the West Midlands.
A flat with great sea views in Margate in Kent, a bungalow in Whaley Thorns in Nottinghamshire and an end terrace in Longbridge in Birmingham are all sold under the hammer.
A listed building in Brentwood in Essex dating back to the 16th-century is sold under the hammer, along with a flat in Halesowen in Birmingham and an end terrace in Northwood in Stoke-on-Trent.

The story of Pennie Davis, whose feud with her ex-partner's son leads him to take extreme measures that she paid for with her life.

When a holistic doctor with a burgeoning TV career is bludgeoned to death inside her home, it's a random tip that leads to justice being served.

After detectives find a popular hairstylist stabbed to death, their suspects include the victim's landlord, her married lover, and an aggressive ex-boyfriend.

Discover an array of mysterious phenomena seen from above, including a Nazi weapon in Northern France, a Russian military tower in the shadow of Chernobyl, and a forgotten Australian tunnel rumoured to hide a nuclear lab.
Discover over a hundred massive concrete arrows scattered across America, a mysterious hole in the middle of a lake in Southern California and more.
A Turkish drought reveals a long-lost Basilica and its secrets, while the hull of a ship in the North Sea answers decades-old questions.
Nubian pyramids reveal the rise of female power in Ancient Kush, while satellite images uncover secrets of an ancient Puebloan site in New Mexico.

Discover strange markings in the remote region of Northern Finland and reveal secrets found deep in the Antarctic. Drones find a Manhattan-sized mystery in a Vietnamese cave and a lost sky-high world in Mozambique gets a visit from above.
Drones reveal what's left of Henry Ford's American suburb in the Brazilian jungle, while clues to what killed a once-vibrant Pennsylvania mining town is discovered.
Look down over a constant inferno in Turkmenistan, mysterious circles in the Namibian desert and secret electric blue ponds in Utah.

Witness a remote island linked to one of the world's most famous aviation mysteries, explore thousands of shipwrecks in the Bermuda Triangle, and discover a 10,000-year-old mystery in the murky depths of the Yucatán Peninsula.
With its ties to the Last Supper and the crucifixion of Jesus Christ, the Holy Grail has been an object of mystery and fascination for centuries, attracting treasure hunters, kings, and crusaders.
Meet the man who paints cliffs bright green and explore Zimbabwe's abandoned places. Plus, visit India's largest vegetable market and a truly unique village in China.
Visit Italy's most fascinating ghost town, learn about an edible bird nest in Malaysia, and explore the Bollate Prison. Plus, check out a structure dubbed the Dr Seuss House.
When Pharaoh Ptolemy IV confronts Antiochus the Great at Raphia, 100,000 men from the Mediterranean clash in a battle that uses military and naval strategies inspired by Alexander the Great.
pr.sub: Ptolemy IV - The Battle Of Raphia

pr.d: The death of Robert Dudley's wife in 1560 caused a scandal - as the nobleman was Elizabeth I's alleged lover.
pr.sub: Amy Dudley: The Queen, Her Lover and His Wife

pr.d: Investigating strange objects found hidden inside the Great Pyramid at Giza, a polished wooden device designed to bombard the human body with potentially lethal X-rays, and a controversial terracotta sculpture.
pr.sub: The Pyramid Tool Kit, the Killer Foot Machine and the Lost Head

pr.d: The Solway Firth Spaceman: Experts investigate the mystery of the Solway Firth Spaceman, a spacesuit-clad figure who strangely appeared in a photograph taken in Cumbria.
Some believe that extraterrestrials cause atmospheric light shows and question whether they pose an imminent threat to humanity.
Did the space race stop at just the Moon? Is there any truth to rumours of a secret Space Force developed by America for missions beyond Earth's orbit?
From 1969 to 1973, US forces bomb Cambodia and the country falls into a brutal form of communism. Did the US' involvement pave the way for Pol Pot's regime?

Cleopatra attempts to restore the power of the early pharaohs through alliances with the most powerful men in the world. Her clash with Octavian at the battle of Actium leads to the rise of an emperor.
An exploration of crime and punishment in Ancient Egypt filled with homicidal royalty, rampant tomb raiding and acts of extreme punishment.
With the help of modern science, uncover the secrets of Ancient Egypt's health and wealth, from Queen Hatshepsut's death to the world's oldest case of breast cancer.
Adam, Gwen and Julie recall personal encounters with UFOs, before experts' theories are put in doubt when we learn that each individual has time missing from their encounters.
Homicide detective Rod Demery and scientist Professor Turi King visit the ancient city of Verona, Italy, to examine the death of a 14th-century warlord.
Examine a 9,000-year-old clay head, a 1950s machine built to control the weather, and a map which could be the oldest ever found.
pr.sub: The Jericho Head, The Cloudbuster And The Map

pr.d: Examine a hat emblazoned with teeth, a box with the power to kill, and a golden quiver from a Macedonian tomb.
pr.sub: The Hat Of Teeth, The Killer Shockbox And The Amazonian Quiver

pr.d: Uncovering new evidence pointing to the possibility that ancient man was visited by extraterrestrials. Influencing ancient technologies, architecture and art.
Explores the history of UFO sightings in Melbourne, as some local Victorians open up about their otherworldly encounters.
From an Egyptian temple carved into cliffs to the world's oldest ritual hunting sites, discoveries are redefining history.
pr.sub: Hidden Temple Of Athribis & Ice Age Footprints

pr.d: In China, a burial site reveals a child's remains marked with peculiar modifications. This raises questions about Chinese mortuary practices and more.
Examine a 9,000-year-old clay head, a 1950s machine built to control the weather, and a map which could be the oldest ever found.
pr.sub: The Jericho Head, The Cloudbuster And The Map

pr.d: Something is killing the animals. Unexplained livestock deaths in Puerto Rico, and aliens abduct a dog in England.
Despicable duo Raymond Fernandez and Martha Beck team up to con lonely women across the nation, posing as siblings to rob them of their riches.
Ancient remains, rare tools, a sabre-toothed kitten and a silver hoard reveal secrets of the past.
pr.sub: Headless Dead of the Neolithic Valley

Können Satellitenaufnahmen endlich enthüllen, wie El Chapo, einer der berüchtigtsten Drogenbarone der Welt, aus Mexikos Hochsicherheitsgefängnis entkommen konnte? Auf den schottischen Inseln finden Forscher Hinweise auf sieben Ringe im Boden. In der Gegend lebten in der Vergangenheit viele kriegerische Stämme, deren Geschichte bis zu den Wikingern reicht. Aber als die Wissenschaftler dem Rätsel nachgehen, kommen sie zu einem vollkommen anderen Schluss. Außerdem entdecken die Satelliten eine zerstörte Stadt im Pazifik.
Die Sendung zeigt die größten Lkw-Unfälle und Kollisionen, die weltweit gefilmt wurden.

Diese Reise zeigt die erstaunliche Vielfalt der wilden Hunde. Vom arktischen Wolf über den geselligen Dhole bis zum kleinen Fennek und dem langbeinigen Mähnenwolf: Die Reihe entdeckt 37 faszinierende Arten und zeigt ihr Leben.

Der Flughafen in Bogotá gehört zu den wichtigsten Drehkreuzen Lateinamerikas. Jährlich sind dort 23 Millionen Passagiere und mehr als 500.000 Tonnen Transportgüter auf der Durchreise. Die Sicherheitsbeamten haben alle Hände voll zu tun.
Ein Satellitenbild aus dem Jahr 2005 zeigt möglicherweise eine prähistorische Kultstätte.

In England scheinen Satellitenbildern zufolge seltsame Gebäude zu stehen. Forscher sind neugierig. Als sie vor Ort sind, finden sie die Hinterlassenschaften einer furchtbaren Zeit. Auf Hawaii schockiert ein Fund eines steinigen Parallelogramms.

Dort hat die Kontinentalverschiebung eine Vulkankette geschaffen, die sich über fast 10.000 Kilometer erstreckt. pr.d: Ed Gein, der Schlächter von Plainfield, erinnert an Horrorfilme wie "Psycho". Als die Polizei nach einer vermissten Frau sucht, findet sie auf Geins Farm ein Horrorkabinett aus Leichenteilen, das er über zwölf Jahre zusammengestellt hatte.

pr.t: Anwälte der Toten - Die schlimmsten Serienkiller der Welt
pr.d: Der Serienkiller Fritz Honka war über viele Jahre aktiv und misshandelte und ermordete Prostituierte. Nur zufällig wurde er gefasst, als Feuerwehrleute den Verwesungsgeruch bemerkten und dann die zerstückelten Leichen mehrerer Frauen fanden.
pr.sub: Fritz Honka: Der `Frauenmörder von St. Pauli'

pr.d: Militärhubschrauber sind unverzichtbar für die Bundeswehr. Sie dienen vielfältigen Zwecken wie Transport, Kampf und Rettung bei Land-, See- und Lufteinsätzen. Ihre Zuverlässigkeit und Schnelligkeit sind unter allen Bedingungen entscheidend.
pr.sub: Hubschrauber der Bundeswehr - Technik und Einsatz

pr.d: Sechs Monate lang war die Fregatte Mecklenburg-Vorpommern in der Ostsee im Einsatz. Wir werfen einen näheren Blick auf das Leben der Besatzung zwischen NATO-Manövern, ständigen Übungen und alltäglichen Begegnungen mit Russland.

Der Kollaps des Surfside "Condos" in Florida kostete fast 100 Menschen das Leben. Aber was sind die Gründe für die Katastrophe? Auch der Verlust des U-Boots "Kursk" und das Feuer an der Kings-Cross-Station in London werden untersucht.

Drei reale Katastrophen werden mit forensischer Präzision rekonstruiert. Darunter das Zugunglück von Lac-Mégantic, die Explosion in einer Zuckerfabrik in Georgia und außerdem die Havarie der "Ever Given" im Suezkanal im Jahr 2021.

Die F-22 Raptor ist besonders wendig, schnell, kann umfangreich bewaffnet werden und weist hervorragende Tarnkappeneigenschaften vor. Dank einer speziellen Beschichtung ist der Raubvogel für Radarsysteme nahezu unsichtbar.

pr.t: NATO TIGER MEET - Raubkatzen der Lüfte
pr.d: Aus einem Treffen wurde das Manöver NATO Tiger Meet zu einer komplexen Übung mit internationaler Dimension. Im Mittelpunkt stehen deutsche Crews des Taktischen Luftwaffengeschwaders 51 Immelmann, die in Portugal anspruchsvolle Missionen fliegen.

Es wird die Produktion des Kettenfahrzeugs Lynx in Unterlüß und Ungarn begleitet. Ausgestattet mit dem Lance-Turm und modernster Hightech, erkennt er feindliche Angriffe und reagiert mit automatischer Zielverfolgung.

Am 24. März 2015 befindet sich die Maschine des Germanwings-Flugs 9525 auf dem Weg von Barcelona nach Düsseldorf. Urplötzlich verliert der Airbus A320-211 über den Alpen innerhalb kürzester Zeit an Höhe. Sofort leitet die französische Flugsicherung Notfallmaßnahmen ein und versucht, den Piloten zu erreichen. Vergeblich: Der Jet verschwindet vom Radar. Erst Stunden später werden in einer unzugänglichen Bergregion Wrackteile und die Überreste von 150 Menschen entdeckt.

Über der sturmgepeitschten Nordsee wird eine Turboprop-Maschine vom Blitz getroffen. Im Cockpit fallen die Instrumente aus, das Flugzeug rast in die Tiefe, der Aufprall scheint unausweichlich. Bei der Untersuchung wird etwas Ungewöhnliches entdeckt.

pr.t: Border Patrol USA - Einsatz an Mexikos Grenze
pr.d: Bei einem Großeinsatz auf der Juarez-Lincoln Bridge werden zwei Frauen vorläufig festgenommen. Die Beamten überprüfen ihre Fracht auf illegale Schmugglerware. Auch der Lieferwagen eines älteren Mannes wird gründlich untersucht.

pr.t: Border Patrol USA - Einsatz an Mexikos Grenze
pr.d: Auf der Gateway International Bridge suchen die Beamten nach einem Jugendlichen, der von zwei Kidnappern in einem Van entführt wurde. Auf der Juarez-Lincoln Bridge in einem Jeep finden die Beamten jede Menge verstecktes Bargeld.

pr.t: Border Patrol USA - Einsatz an Mexikos Grenze
pr.d: Die Beamten rüsten sich für einen Großeinsatz: Ein Gefangener soll den mexikanischen Behörden übergeben werden, doch alle weiteren Einzelheiten unterliegen strengster Geheimhaltung, denn der Mann wird von einem brutalen Drogenkartell gesucht.

Es wird über eine große Auktion von Pkw-Oldtimern in Dallas, Texas berichtet, bei der an vier Tagen rund 1.000 Pkw versteigert werden. Der Autohändler Dieter Thiel aus Wuppertal hat sich auf US-amerikanische Oldtimer spezialisiert.

Der Ford Mustang ist ein unbestrittener amerikanischer Klassiker. Mit seinem Acht-Zylinder-Motor steht er nach wie vor für Kraft und Freiheit. Auch sechzig Jahre nach ihrem Erscheinen ist die Nachfrage nach gut erhaltenen Exemplaren hoch.
pr.sub: Besser als das Original - Ford Mustang Restaurierung

pr.d: Gezeigt werden Geschichten über Luxusautos, Manufakturen und die Automobilgeschichte.

Es wird ein Blick hinter die Kulissen der größten Waschstraße der Welt in Stuttgart geworfen. Bis zu 4.000 Autowäschen und rund tausend Innenreinigungen nimmt der Familienbetrieb an einem Tag vor. Dafür ist ein enormer logistischer Aufwand nötig.
pr.sub: Waschen, Wachsen, Föhnen - Die größte Waschstraße der Welt

pr.d: Spezial-Fahrzeuge, die das Dreißigfache ihres Eigengewichts bewegen können, werden vorgestellt. Ganz gleich ob Militärfahrzeuge geborgen werden sollen, Flugzeuge oder Raketen bewegt werden sollen: Sie sind optimal auf ihr Einsatzgebiet angepasst.
pr.sub: Abschlepper der Superlative - 1000 Tonnen am Haken

pr.d: No description available · EPGTalk.com

Die Arbeit als Hochseefischer ist trotz moderner Schiffe extrem gefährlich. Stürme, harte körperliche Belastung, unbeständiges Wetter und unsichere Fischpreise führen zu einem ständigen Wettlauf gegen die Naturgewalten und die Zeit.
pr.sub: Auf Fangfahrt mit den deutschen Seelachsfischern

pr.d: Wir werfen einen Blick auf die Seenotretter der DGzRS, die bei Sturm und hohen Wellen auf Nord- und Ostsee im Einsatz sind. Begleitet wird die Crew eines Seenotkreuzers an der Elbmündung, die einen Eindruck von der Arbeit der Helfer vermittelt.
pr.sub: Die Seenotretter - Einsatz bei Wind und Wellen

pr.d: In der ehemaligen Tschechoslowakei rettet Oskar Schindler 1.200 jüdische Frauen und Männer auf einem Fabrikgelände vor dem Holocaust – die Geschichte und der Ort hinter "Schindlers Liste". Ein Ökohotel im Amazonas scheitert am Reality-TV, in Brandenburg bringt ein Kalkwerk Aufschwung mit fatalen Folgen für Arbeiter.

Diese Folge befasst sich mit einer Region des Nahen Ostens, die von Ruinen übersät ist. Außerdem wird in Taiwan ein seltsames Bauwerk erforscht, das die Herzen derjenigen, die seinen wahren Zweck kannten, in Angst und Schrecken versetzte.

Diese Folge wirft einen Blick auf einige unheimliche Ruinen, die in den bewaldeten Hügeln von Arkansas versteckt sind. Außerdem gibt es einen Blick auf ein heruntergekommenes Arbeitslager in Albanien, in dem Staatsfeinde untergebracht waren.

Diese Folge der Sendung wirft einen Blick auf eine Vulkaninsel vor der Küste Taiwans mit gruseligen Ruinen aus einer dunklen Ära. Außerdem wird eine Miniatureisenbahn, die in den Wäldern von Arkansas versteckt ist, erforscht.

Diese Folge der Sendung wirft einen Blick auf das Hartwood Hospital in Lanarkshire, Schottland. Das Gebäude war einst eines der größten psychiatrischen Krankenhäuser in Europa. Experten diskutieren über die dunkle Geschichte des imposanten Gebäudes.

Die Dokumentation zeigt die im Wald gelegenen höhlenartigen Kuppelbauten in Indien, die seit ihrer Darstellung durch die Beatles als "Ashram" berühmt geworden sind. Die heute bröckelnden Bauten waren einst der Gipfel des spirituellen Luxus.

Sie begegneten einander nie und blieben doch dauerhaft aufeinander fixiert: Hitler und Stalin. Sie stiegen auf zu Führern von Diktaturen, die an blutiger Gewalt alles übertrafen, was menschlicher Wille zur Macht bis dahin an Grausamkeit hervorgebracht hatte. Scheinbar gesichertes Wissen liefert neue Einsichten in alte Fragestellungen: Wie werden Menschen zu Diktatoren.

At the playground, Pedro and Penny's glasses fall off; both think that their glasses are broken, as they cannot see very well; Madame Gazelle shows Pedro and Penny different types of objects with lenses.
It's a snowy day and Peppa's family build an igloo for their snowman. They hide in it during a snowstorm, but Penny Polar Bear and her parents love snowstorms and also Peppa's igloo.

Peppa and her friends are at playgroup when they learn that Mr. Bull and Mrs. Cow are getting married the next day; everyone goes into a panic when they confess how they have done nothing to prepare for the big day.

Everyone prepares for Mr. Bull and Mrs. Cow's wedding; Peppa and the soon-to-be-weds go to the jewellers to get rings, to the dressmakers, to get a wedding dress and finally to Peppa's house to sort the wedding cake.
Holly spends the day with King Thistle on his royal duties. King Thistle must launch an elf boat, judge a fairy fruit competition and make a speech at the festival.
The children are at the Elf Farm, but to learn where milk comes from they must visit a big farm, to find cows. The children travel to Lucy Big's farm, where she shows them all the animals.
Peppa's family are at Digger World, where they have fun building walls and knocking them over again, and even help Mr Bull when there's an obstacle in the road.
Teddy needs mending and cleaning after rolling down hills and jumping in muddy puddles, so Peppa takes her to Miss Rabbit's Doll Hospital.

Mummy Pig is determined that George's new hat doesn't get muddy when Peppa and George visit Grandpa and Granny Pig. Everyone tries to make sure that it stays clean, even if it means that they get messy instead.
Mummy Dog surprises Captain Daddy Dog with a gift of a boat trip for his birthday, but when Peppa and the gang come along, the trip doesn't go to plan.
Madame Gazelle and Mr Bull lead the children to the wildflower wood to learn all about flowers; the children enjoy identifying the flowers like Wild Garlic, Bluebells and even a rare orchid.
Peppa and George play in their grandparents' garden on a very hot day, but they don't have a paddling pool; Granny and Grandpa Pig create their own water squeezers and even a water slide.
Mummy Elephant invites Peppa and Daddy Pig to perform magic at Emily's birthday party. Peppa shows her friends how the magic trick works.
Daddy Pig receives a jumping stick in the mail and demonstrates to Peppa and George how to use it. Peppa and her friends struggle with using it first.
Miss Rabbit gives Peppa and her friends a tennis lesson, but the tennis balls get everywhere. Mr Stallion and Miss Corgi arrive with strawberries and cream.
Peppa and her family are on a caravan adventure; the first stop is the biggest potato in the world; when it starts to get too foggy, they park up for a rest before another busy day.
Bruno the brakeman learns the importance of teamwork and friendship when the engines help him complete his tasks during an unexpected windstorm.
Paddington builds a robot that he calls Paddington that requires a real friend to work, Baaz invites everyone to celebrate Diwali with him, and Paddington is his helpful assistant.
pr.sub: Paddington Meets Paddingtron; Paddington's First Diwali

pr.d: Paddington has a race against time in order to enjoy his first ever solar eclipse. Paddington accepts an inventor's award for Simi when she's too shy to step up, but it makes Simi feel jealous and sad.
pr.sub: Paddington and the Solar Eclipse; Paddington and the Mysterious Inventor

pr.d: The Browns meet Shantee the lighthouse keeper when they arrive at the beach for their holiday. Paddington, Jonathan, and Judy become trainee lifeguards and end up rescuing Mr Brown with Taylor the lifeguard's help.
pr.sub: Paddington's Summer Holiday Begins; Paddington's Life Guard Training

pr.d: Something is making the strange noises in the cave. Jonathan thinks it's a mermaid, but Paddington isn't so sure. Judy wants to find a fossil on the beach, but everyone else seems to be getting lucky except her. Paddington tries to help.
pr.sub: Paddington's Mysterious Cave Discovery; Paddington and the Fossil Hunt

pr.d: Peppa and her friends, accompanied by Mummy Sheep and Granny Sheep, take Vanessa to Grampy Rabbit's boatyard for inspiration. The children create various artworks using items found around the yard.
While Mummy and Daddy Pig attend a refresher antenatal class, Peppa and George join Miss Rabbit's Sibling School where they learn about what to expect when their new sibling arrives.
Peppa eagerly awaits her new sibling, growing impatient with the lengthy wait. Suddenly, Mummy Pig announces that the baby is coming right now.
The Pig family go to the hospital, where Peppa is determined to find the perfect name for the baby.
The nurse visits and decides to focus on teaching proper baby-holding techniques. She demonstrates a safe method for a small person, like Peppa, to hold an infant correctly.
George undergoes a medical examination to assess his hearing. The results of the test reveal moderate hearing loss in his left ear, marking an important milestone in his health and development.
Peppa is excited to help George explore the world of sounds now he has his hearing aid. She shows him her favourite sounds including the splashing of jumping in a muddy puddle!
Grandpa Pig and Grandad Dog are on their boats when Grandpa Pig drops an anchor on his foot! After an x-ray and plaster cast at the hospital, Grandpa Pig needs to stay overnight.
Mayor Humdinger has been carving his face into the cliffs of Adventure Bay.
Carlos and Tracker make pawpaw juice with the PAW Patrol when they find out Mayor Goodway and Chickaletta are in trouble.
Judy finds her inner hero on the Rangers Camping trip as they need to shelter from the weather; Paddington befriends a speedy snail with a heroic future ahead, but also looks so sad.
pr.sub: Paddington's Race Against the Storm; Paddington's Super Snail

pr.d: Paddington and Robot Paddington enjoy being heroes, Paddington discovers how to be calm.
pr.sub: Paddington and Paddingtron's Heroic Day / Paddington's Heroic Non-Stop Adventure

pr.d: Paddington tries to figure out who stole Mr. Curry's prized Giant Pumpkin, Mr. Gruber teaches Paddington how to skate for the ice disco.
pr.sub: Paddington and the Vegetable Thief; Paddington Takes to the Ice

pr.d: Tim searches the kitchen, reads labels and ingredients to find a hogweed-free snack for Kai.
Tim tries to bend all the rules when Terri comes to babysit.
Tim tries to get rid of a troublesome spider from his house.
A gang of squirrels appear at the Great Elf Tree. They are determined to store their acorns inside, but the Wise Old Elf has a cunning plan to stop them.
Out playing in the meadow, Holly, Ben and their friends find a broken toy robot. Holly fixes it with magic, but the robot does not behave as they thought it would.
Stan, Grace and Brody form a band, but a mystery drummer joins in somewhere across town. Stan and Gran go on a hunt for their invisible bandmate!
Strange holes in garden fences are popping up all over Porthole and Stink has gone missing! Stan and Gran spy a mystery and decide to investigate.
PAW Patrol is a CG action-adventure preschool series starring a pack of six heroic puppies led by a tech-savvy 10-year-old boy named Ryder.
pr.sub: Pups and the Ace of the Skies; Pups Save the Babysitter

pr.d: Farmer Al's new machine, the Garboni, goes haywire, and it's up to Ryder and the Paw Patrol to stop it before it gives them the slip. The Paw Patrol have to catch a trouble-making sleepy porcupine and bring it back to the woods.
pr.sub: Pups Stop the Garboni; Pups Save the Porcupine

pr.d: Bobbi befriends some space rock aliens. They love playing with Bobbi and refuse to let him go. Professor Scratch invents a tracker to locate all of Sir Steel's missing socks which come to life!
pr.sub: Rocks To The Rescue / Sock Shock

pr.d: Rubble moves with his family of construction pups to the nearby town of Builder Cove where they [LIVE], play and build whatever the community needs.
pr.sub: The Crew Fixes A Blocked Pipe/The Crew Builds A Construction Basketball Show

pr.d: There's a pirate-themed holiday in town, but Zuma isn't in a festive mood. His revamped persona gets tested when a real pirate arrives, bent on hidden treasure and ready to destroy the town to get it!
Sir Steel sails towards a purple slime waterfall unaware, as he's too busy meditating. Drillnose Beetles are destroying the forest and so two mystery heroes have to reveal themselves.
pr.sub: Steel Man Steel; The Mystery Heroes

pr.d: Kai is super excited to ride the Nebulator, but Tim is not so sure.
Tim and Dad have to catch a troublesome mole.
Tim, Tia and Tommy try to convince Mum and Dad to let them have a pet.
The Gabby Cats need to make a special art project for Baby Box's Meow-Seum Day; with many different ways to make art, who knows what they'll create.
When Gabby and Pandy turn tiny from one of MerCat's potions, they'll need to gather the right ingredients to help them grow back to their usual size.
Begonia, Lily, and Blossom teach Wild a lesson after he steals their cupcakes; Chef is worried when the main ingredient for his famous Equinox pie, the Yummyus, is late blooming.
pr.sub: Wild Gets Tamed; The Yummyus Pie

pr.d: The Crew makes the biggest pancake ever in 'The Crew Builds A Pancake Café', then in 'The Crew Builds An Aeroplane Wash', the pups wash Camila's plane.
pr.sub: The Crew Builds A Pancake Cafe / The Crew Builds An Airplane Wash

pr.d: When the Hidden Jungle animals appear to be uncharacteristically frightened, Marshall discovers a sabre-toothed tiger has been stalking them. The big-fanged tiger is not the only creature strangely awakening from long, long ago.
pr.sub: Jungle Pups: Pups Save the Big, Big Animals

pr.d: Humdinger and Boomer join forces to get Roxy out of the way so that the two can put on the ultimate monster truck show and Humdinger can show off for his mum.
pr.sub: Rescue Wheels: Pups vs. The Monster Mayor

pr.d: Adventure Bay gets a brand-new airport, and Sweetie tries to take the Princess' place at the grand opening.
Peppa and George are helping Grandpa Pig to dig a new pond for his garden. While digging, they find hidden treasure so they go to see Mr Richard in the museum.
Madame Gazelle gets Peppa and her playgroup friends to dance to all different styles of music.
Peppa and family take a trip to the market to buy some apples, cheese and fish. However, they get more than they were expecting when they stop by Mr Fox's stall as he is selling some special items.

Daddy Pig receives a letter saying he must go away on business to test some very important concrete. Peppa, Mummy and George all decide to go with Daddy and enjoy a train journey, where they sing to pass the time.
With the building work complete, it's time to decorate! Peppa and George have fun choosing how to decorate their new attic bedrooms. It's dinosaurs for George, but what will Peppa pick?
Madame Gazelle is making a wicker basket. She explains it is her hobby - something you do to relax. The children discuss hobbies and learn about each other's favourite things to do.
After seeing an advert for the London Marathon, Daddy Pig applies to take part to show the kids what grit and determination really looks like!
When Peppa decides to walk up the big hill during their family hike in the countryside, Daddy Pig assures her that the hard climb will be worth it.
Poor Gaston the ladybird has never had a birthday party, but this changes when King Thistle finds out.
A magical card arrives in the Little Kingdom, inviting everyone to a party at Granny and Granpapa Thistle's castle in the clouds.
The children are playing a game of superheroes. When Strawberry takes her super villain role a bit too far, it is up to the 'Elf Man' and 'Fairy Girl' to save the day.
When Redbeard, who is giving Nanny Plum, Ben and Holly a ride on his 'unsinkable' boat, hits a rock, he calls on the services of Elf Rescue.
When Francois accidentally crashes his diving bell, the PAW Patrol must rescue him; when Wingnut's junk pile and Oscar go missing at the same time, Chase and team are called in to solve the mystery.
pr.sub: Pups Save the Whale Pod; Ultimate Rescue: Pups Stop the Junk-Monster

pr.d: Ryan Reynolds reads stories to help the world fall asleep. Tonight Ryan shares some tales that speak to the soul.
Peppa and George go behind the scenes to find out how TV is made when Miss Rabbit shows them around the set of Super Potato's TV show.
Mummy, Daddy, Peppa and George go to the park. Peppa and George play on the hopping logs, the bouncing branch and the monkey bars.
Peppa and the rest of the playgroup put on a big Christmas show for all the parents. While Danny Dog is dressed up as a Santa, the real Father Christmas pays them a visit.
Mummy and Daddy Pig get stuck behind Mrs Badger's tractor on the way to her farm, where Peppa and George learn about how useful tractors can be, even if they aren't very fast.
It is a special day because Mummy and Daddy Pig have big news to tell Peppa and George, but they struggle to wait!
While Mummy and Daddy Pig attend a refresher antenatal class, Peppa and George join Miss Rabbit's Sibling School where they learn about what to expect when their new sibling arrives.
Peppa celebrates Goldie's birthday by holding an undersea party - by turning the house into an underwater environment.

When a storm cancels Peppa and her family's outdoor adventure plans, they decide to bring the fun indoors. Using their imagination, they go sledding, climb a mountain and enjoy a campfire in the attic.
King Thistle is bored in the Royal Castle and takes up the hobby of birdwatching. Using his magic bird book, the King is pleased when another creature makes a nest in the Royal Castle.
King Thistle has a cold and needs some medicine. Nanny Plum, Holly, and Ben, have a lot of fun collecting the ingredients to make a magic potion to cure his cold and make him better.
When Percy and Kana have a near-collision, they enlist Safety Engine Emily and go to ridiculous extremes to introduce safety measures all over Sodor.
When Bulstrode and Cranky get into their crankiest fight yet, they learn how to express their feelings in order to save their friendship.
Dora and Boots help Benny perfect a new move in time for the championship volleyball game. Dora and Boots show Dulce the dragon that everyone's differences are what make them excellent!
Join Tim Rex as he tackles kid-shaped problems with dino-sized solutions in space! Tim and Kai go crater surfing and attempt a cool new trick.
Tim and Kai compete to get Terri's spare Space-Land ticket.
Join Tim Rex as he tackles kid-shaped problems with dino-sized solutions in space! Tim and Kai attempt to rebuild Dad's childhood spaceship.
Mr. Curry is sure there's a monster in the park lake, and Paddington sets out to help him prove it.
pr.sub: Paddington and the Lake Monster; Paddington's Space Radio
